G5608.definition: ὠνέομαι, -οῦραι; to buy: ὠνήσατο (= cl. ἐπρίατο; see Rutherford, NPhr., 210 ff.; Veitch, see word), with genitive pret., Act.7:16.†; (AS)

G5609.definition: ᾠόν; (Rec. ὠόν), -οῦ, τό [in LXX for בֵּיצָה ;]; an egg: Luk.11:12.†; (AS)

G5610.definition: ὥρα, -ας, ἡ,; [in LXX chiefly for עֵת and in Da for שָׁעָה ;]; __1. any time or period fixed by nature, esp. a season (Hom., Hdt., Plat., al.).; __2. A part of the day, and esp. a twelfth part of day or night, an hour: Mat.24:36, Mrk.13:32, Act.10:3, al.; accus. in ans. to "when"? (M, Pr., 63, 215; Bl., §34, 8), Jhn.4:52, Act.10:3, 30 1Co.15:30, Rev.3:3; accusative of duration, Mat.20:12 26, Mrk.14:37; inexactly, πρὸς ὥραν, for a season, for a time, Jhn.5:35, 2Co.7:8, Gal.2:5; πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας, for a short season (ICC, in l.), 1Th.2:17.; __3. A definite point of time, time, hour: Mat.26:45; with genitive of thing(s), Luk.1:10 14:17, Rev.3:10, al.; with genitive of person(s), Luk.22:53, Jhn.2:4 7:30, al.; ἡ ἄρτι ὥρα, 1Co.4:11; ἐσχάτη ὥ., 1Jn.2:18; before ὅτε, Jhn.4:21, 23 5:25 16:25; ἵνα, Jhn.12:23, al.; with accusative and inf., Rom.13:11 (cf. DB, ext., 475b 476b).; (AS)

G5611.definition: ὡραῖος, -α, -ον; (ὥρα), [in LXX for נָאָה, טוֹב, יָפָה, etc. ;]; seasonable, timely, esp. of ripe fruits; hence, blooming, beautiful (both of things and persons): Mat.23:27, Act.3:2, 10, Rom.10:15 (LXX, ὥρα).†; (AS)
G5611.description: The Beautiful Gate was a gate of the Jerusalem temple, where Peter healed a lame man. (Act.3.2, 10)

G5612.definition: ὠρύομαι  depon.,; [in LXX for שָׁאַג ;]; of animals (also of men, Hdt., al.), to roar, howl: λέων, 1Pe.5:8.†; (AS)

G5613.definition: ὡς, adverbial form of the relative pron. ὅς, ἥ, ὅ.; __I. As relat. adv. of manner, as, like as, just as, even as;; __1. with a demonstrative, like οὕτως, expressed or understood: οὕτως . . . ὡς, Mrk.4:26, 1Co.3:15, Eph.5:28, Jas.2:12, al.; ὡς . . . οὕτως, Act.8:32, 1Co.7:17, al.; elliptically (sc. οὕτως, οὕτω), with nom., Mat.6:29, al.; with accusative, Mat.19:19, Mrk.12:31, al.; with prep., Mat.26:55, Mrk.14:48, Luk.22:52, Jhn.7:10, al.; with verb., Jhn.15:6, 2Co.3:1, Eph.2:3, 1Th.5:6, al.; with ptcp. (the ptcp. however not having the special force wh. it has in cl.; see Bl., §73, 5; 74, 6), Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, Heb.13:17, al.; freq implying opinion or belief, Rom.9:32;  so esp, with genitive absol., 1Co.4:18, 2Co.5:20, 1Pe.4:12, 2Pe.1:3.; __2. Before numerals, about, nearly: Mrk.5:13, Jhn.1:40, Act.5:7, al.; __3. Before adjectives and adverbs, how: Rom.10:15 11:33, 1Th.2:10; with superl., ὡς τάχιστα, as quickly as possible, Act.17:15.; __II. As conjunction;; __1. temporal,; __(a) as, when, since: Mrk.9:21 14:72, Luk.1:23, Jhn.2:9, al.;; __(b) while, when, as long as: Luk.12:58, Jhn.12:36, Gal.6:10 (Field, Notes, 191); ὡς ἄν (M, Pr., 167, and see: ἄν), Rom.15:24, 1Co.11:34, Php.2:23.; __2. Final, in order that; with inf., in order to (M, Pr., 204n), Luk.9:52, Act.20:24, Heb.7:9.; (AS)

G5614.definition: ὡσαννά (T, ὠσ-) (Heb נָא and הוֹשֵׁעַ; see Dalman, Words, 220 IL; Gr., 249),; hosanna: Mat.21:9, Mrk.11:9-10, Jhn.12:13; τ. υἱῷ Δανείδ, Mat.21:9, 15.†; (AS)
G5614.description: Hosanna, a Hebrew expression meaning "save now" or "save, please," was shouted by the crowds during Jesus' triumphal entry into Jerusalem, acknowledging Him as the Messiah (Matthew 21:9, 15; Mrk.11.9-10; Jhn.12.13).

G5615.definition: ὡσαύτως; adv.,; strengthened for ὡς (in Hom, at the beginning of a clause, in the form ὣς δ᾽ αὔτως, later in one word), in like manner, just so, likewise: Mat.20:5 21:30, 36 25:17, Mrk.14:31, Luk.13:5 20:31, Rom.8:26, 1Ti.5:25, Tit.2:6; with verb to be supplied from context, Mrk.12:21, Luk.22:20, 1Co.11:25, 1Ti.2:9 3:8 3:11, Tit.2:3.†; (AS)

G5616.definition: ὡσεί; adv.,; __(a) as if, .as it were, like as, like: Mat.3:16 9:36, Act.2:3 6:15, Rom.6:13, Heb.1:12; γίνεσθαι (φαίνεσθαι) ὡσεί, Mrk.9:26, Luk.22:44 ([WH] R, mg., om.), Luk.24:11;; __(b) in calculation, and with numbers, about: Mat.14:21, Luk.3:23 9:14, 28 22:41, 59 23:44, Act.2:41 10:3 19:7; ὡσεὶ λίθου βολήν, Luk.22:41.†; (AS)

G5617.definition: Ὠσηέ (Tr., Ὁσ-), ὁ (Heb. הוֹשֵׁעַ),; Hosea: Rom.9:25.†; (AS)

G5618.definition: ὥσ-περ; adv.,; just as, even as: Mat.6:2 20:28, Act.3:17, 1Co.8:5, 1Th.5:3 al.; in protasis, with οὕτως (καί) in apodosis: Mat.12:40, Luk.17:24, Jhn.5:21, Rom.5:19, Gal.4:29, Jas.2:26, al; (AS)

G5619.definition: ὡσ-περ-εί; adv.,; as, as it were: 1Co.15:8.†; (AS)

G5620.definition: ὥσ-τε; consecutive particle,; __1. with infin., expressing result, so as to: Mat.8:24 12:22, Mrk.1:27, Luk.5:7, Act.1:19, Rom.7:6, 1Co.1:7, Heb.13:6, al.; of a designed result, Mat.10:1, Luk.4:29, al.; preceded by οὕτως, Act.14:1; by τοσοῦτος, Mat.15:33.; __2. C. indic.,; __(a) so that: Gal.2:13, preceded by οὕτως, Jhn.3:16;; __(b) so then, therefore: Mat.12:12, Mrk.2:28, Rom.7:4, 1Co.3:7, Gal.3:9, al.; __3. so then, therefore: with subjc., 1Co.5:8; with imperat., 1Co.3:21 4:5, Php.2:12 1Th.4:18, 1Pe.4:19, al; (AS)

G5621.definition: ὠτίον, -ου, τό, dimin. of οὖς,; [in LXX for אֹזֶן ;]; an ear: Mat.26:51, Luk.22:51, Jhn.18:26.†; (AS)

G5622.definition: ὠφέλεια (WH, -λία), -ας, ἡ; [in LXX for יָעַל hi., בֶּצַע, etc. ;]; __1. assistance, help (Thuc., Plat., al.).; __2. profit, advantage, benefit (Hdt., Plat., al.): Rom.3:1, Ju 16.†; (AS)

G5623.definition: ὠφελέω, -ῶ; (ὄφελος), [in LXX chiefly for יָעַל hi. ;]; to help, benefit, do good, profit: absol., Rom.2:25; οὐδέν (do no good; see Field, Notes, 21), Mat.27:24, Jhn.6:63 12:19; with accusative of person(s), Heb.4:2; with dupl. accusative, Mrk.8:36, 1Co.14:6, Gal.5:2; pass., Heb.13:9; with accusative, Mat.15:5 16:26, Mrk.5:26 7:11, Luk.9:25, 1Co.13:3.†; (AS)

G5624.definition: ὠφέλιμος, -ον; (ὠφελέω),; useful, serviceable, profitable: with dative commod., Tit.3:8; before πρός, with accusative, 1Ti.4:8, 2Ti.3:16.†; (AS)

H1.definition: father of an individual; of God as father of his people; head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan; ancestor (grandfather, forefathers - of person; of people); originator or patron of a class, profession, or art; of producer, generator (fig.); of benevolence and protection (fig.); term of respect and honour; ruler or chief (spec.); Also means: av (אַב "father" H0002)

senses.text: of God as father of his people
head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan
originator or patron of a class, profession, or art

H3.definition: freshness, fresh green, green shoots, or greenery; Aramaic equivalent: ev (אֵב "fruit" H0004)

H4.definition: fruit, fresh, young, greening; Aramaic of ev (אֵב "greenery" H0003)

H5.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10; § Abagtha = "God-given"; one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus
H5.description: Abagtha was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus.

H11.definition: Abaddon, a place of destruction, destruction, ruin
H11.description: Abaddon is a Hebrew term used in the Old Testament to refer to the realm of the dead or the place of destruction .

H14.definition: to be willing, consent ((Qal); to be willing; to consent, yield to, accept; to desire)

H17.definition: Oh!, Woe!, (exclamation of pain - indicates desire or uneasiness)

H21.definition: A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.18.2;; daughter of: Zechariah (H2148C); married to Ahaz (H0271);; mother of: Hezekiah (H2396); also called Abijah at 2Ch.29.1;; Also named: a.viy.yah (אֲבִיָּה "Abijah" H0029N); § Abi = "my father"; mother of Hezekiah (cf H029)
H21.description: Abi, also known as Abijah, was the mother of King Hezekiah and the daughter of Zechariah.

H22.definition: Abiel = "El (God) is (my) father"; Saul's grandfather, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.9.1;; son of: Zeror (H6872C); married to Maacah (H4601N);; father of: Kish (H7027), Ner (H5369), Abdon (H5658J), Zur (H6698I), Baal (H1168B), Nadab (H5070J), Gedor (H1446I), Ahio (H0283I), Zecher (H2144) and Mikloth (H4732); also called Jeiel (Ketiv: Jeuel; KJV: Jehiel) at 1Ch.9.35;  Ner at 1Ch.8.33; 9.39;
H22.description: Abiel, also known as Jeiel, Ner, or Abigibeon (or '[re]-founder of Gibeon'), was the father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul.

H23.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.24;; son of: Korah (H7141I);; brother of: Assir (H0617) and Elkanah (H0511);; father of: Assir (H0617H) and Kore (H6981); also called Abiasaph at Exo.6.24;  Asaph at 1Ch.26.1;; Another name of ev.ya.saph (אֶבְיָסָף, אֲבִיאָסָף "Ebiasaph" H0043); § Abiasaph = "my father has gathered"; son (descendant) of Korah

H24.definition: Month of exodus and passover (March or April); Also named: ni.san (נִיסָן "Nisan" H5212); This name means fresh, young barley ears, barley
H24.description: Abib, later known as Nisan, was the first month of the Hebrew religious calendar, in which the Passover was celebrated .

H25.definition: Abi Gibon = "father of Gibeon"; site of great Bamah, location of the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place

H26.definition: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.25.3; married to David (H1732) and Nabal (H5037);; mother of: Chileab (H3609); § Abigail = "my father is joy"; wife of Nabal, then of David
H26.description: Abigail, initially the wife of Nabal, became one of David's wives after Nabal's death and bore him a son named Chileab.

H27.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.11;; son of: Gideoni (H1441); § Abidan = "my father is judge"; a prince (ruler) of Benjamin
H27.description: Abidan, son of Gideoni, was the leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

H28.definition: A man of the Midianites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.4;; son of: Midian (H4080);; brother of: Ephah (H5891), Epher (H6081), Hanoch (H2585I) and Eldaah (H0420); § Abida or Abidah = "my father knows"; fourth son of Midian and grandson of Abraham by his wife Keturah (after Sarah died)
H28.description: Abida was a son of Midian and a grandson of Abraham through his concubine Keturah.

H29.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.8.2;; son of: Samuel (H8050);; brother of: Joel (H3100); § Abia or Abiah or Abijah = "Jehovah is (my) father"; second son of Samuel
H29.description: Abiah was the wife of Hezron who bore Ashhur after her husband's death.

H250.definition: Someone descended from Ezrah(?), first mentioned at 1Ki.4.31; § Ezraite = "a native (as arising out of the soil)"; Ezrahite, of the family of Zerach

H251.definition: : male-sibling; brother (brother of same parents; half-brother (same father); relative, kinship, same tribe; each to the other (reciprocal relationship); (fig.) of resemblance)

H252.definition: brother; Aramaic of ach (אָח ": male-sibling" H0251)

H256.definition: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.16.28;; son of: Omri (H6018); married to Jezebel (H0348);; father of: Joash (H3101H), Ahaziah (H0274), Joram (H3141H), Athaliah (H6271); § Ahab = "father's brother"; king of Israel, son of Omri, husband of Jezebel; false prophet executed by Nebuchadrezzar, time of Jeremiah
H256.description: Ahab, son of Omri, reigned as king of Israel and did evil in the sight of the Lord.

H257.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.29;; son of: Abishur (H0051) and Abihail (H0032H);; brother of: Molid (H4140); § Ahban = "brother of an understanding (intelligent) one"; son of Abishur of Judah
H257.description: Ahban was the son of Abishur, a descendant of Judah.

H258.definition: (Hithpael) to go one way or another, to be sharp

H259.definition: one (number) (one (number); each, every; a certain; an (indefinite article); only, once, once for all; one...another, the one...the other, one after another, one by one; first; eleven (in combination), eleventh (ordinal))

children.text: one...another, the one...the other, one after another, one by one

H261.definition: A Judge of the tribe of Benjamin living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.3.15;; son of: Gera (H1617);; father of: Naaman (H5283J), Ahijah (H0281K), Gera (H1617J), Uzza (H5798H) and Ahihud (H0284); Another spelling of e.hud (אֵהוּד "Ehud" H0164); § Ehud = "united"; great grandson of Benjamin

H263.definition: declaration, a declaring; Aramaic of ach.vah (אַחְוָה "declaration" H0262)

H265.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.9;; son of: Bela (H1106A);; brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031) and Abishua (H0050H); also called Ahoah at 1Ch.8.4;; Also named: a.cho.chi (אֲחוֹחִי "Ahohite" H0266); § Ahoah = "brother of rest"; a grandson of Benjamin
H265.description: The Ahohites, descendants of Ahoah of Benjamin, were a clan that included some of David's mighty men, such as Eleazar and Zalmon.

H266.definition: Someone descended from Ahoah, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.9;; son of: Bela (H1106A);; brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031) and Abishua (H0050H); also called Ahoah at 1Ch.8.4;; Group of a.cho.ach (אֲחוֹחַ "Ahoah" H0265); § Ahohite = "brother of rest"; one of the clan of Ahoah

H267.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.2;; son of: Jahath (H3189);; brother of: Lahad (H3855); § Ahumai = "a water reed: brother of waters"; grandson of Shobal, descendant of Judah
H267.description: Ahumai was a descendant of Judah through his grandson Reaiah.

H268.definition: the back side, the rear (backwards; hereafter (of time); behind)

H269.definition: sister (sister (same parents); half-sister (same father); relative; (metaph) of Israel's and Judah's relationship; beloved; bride; (fig.) of intimate connection; another)

H270.definition: grasp, take hold, seize, take possession ((Qal) to grasp, take hold of; (Niphal) to be caught, grasped, be settled; (Piel) to enclose, overlay; (Hophal) fastened)

senses.text: grasp, take hold, seize, take possession

children.text: (Niphal) to be caught, grasped, be settled

H271.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.15.38;; son of: Jotham (H3147H); married to Abi (H0021);; father of: Hezekiah (H2396) and Maaseiah (H4641J); Also named: Achaz (Ἀχάζ "Ahaz" G0881); § Ahaz = "he has grasped"; king of Judah, son Jotham, father of Hezekiah; a Benjamite, son of Micah, and great grandson of Jonathan
H271.description: Ahaz was a descendant of Saul and Jonathan, from the tribe of Benjamin.

H273.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi  living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.12;; son of: Meshillemith (H4921);; father of: Jahzerah (H3170); also called Ahzai (KJV: Ahasai) at Neh.11.13;; Another name of me.shul.lam (מְשֻׁלָּם "Meshullam" H4918M); § Ahasai = "my holder, protector"; a post-exilic priest, in Jerusalem

H274.definition: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.40;; son of: Ahab (H0256) and Jezebel (H0348);; brother of: Joash (H3101H), Joram (H3141H) and Athaliah (H6271); § Ahaziah = "Jehovah (Yahu) holds (possesses)"; ruler of Israel, son of Ahab; ruler of Judah, son of Jehoram (Joram)
H274.description: Ahaziah, son of Ahab, reigned as king of Israel for two years.

H275.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.6;; son of: Ashhur (H0806) and Naarah (H5292B);; brother of: Hepher (H2660), Temeni (H8488) and Haahashtari (H0326);; half-brother of: Zereth (H6889), Izhar (H3328), Ethnan (H0869) and Koz (H6976); § Ahuzam = "possessor"; a descendant of Judah through Caleb
H275.description: Ahuzzam was the son of Ashhur and his wife Naarah, from the tribe of Judah.

H276.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.26.26; § Ahuzzath = "possession"; friend of Abimelech
H276.description: Ahuzzath was a friend and advisor of Abimelech, the Philistine king of Gerar, who accompanied him when making a treaty with Isaac.

H277.definition: A man of the tribe of Gad  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.15;; son of: Abdiel (H5661); § Ahi = "my brother"; a head of the families of Gad; an Asherite
H277.description: Ahi, son of Abdiel, was a chief of the Gadites.

H278.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21;; son of: Benjamin (H1144);; brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Aharah at 1Ch.8.1;; Also named: ach.rach (אַחְרַח "Aharah" H0315); § Ehi = "my brother"; son of Benjamin

H279.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.33;; son of: Sharar (H8325); § Ahiam = "mother's brother"; one of David's warriors (heroes)
H279.description: Ahiam, son of Sharar the Hararite, was one of David's mighty men.

H280.definition: puzzle, riddle; Aramaic of chi.dah (חִידָה "riddle" H2420)

H281.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.3;; son of: Seraiah (H8304);; brother of: Elihoreph (H0456); § Ahiah or Ahijah = "brother of Jehovah (Yahu)"; grandson of Phinehas; scribe of Solomon; a prophet who predicted the revolt of the Northern tribes; father of Baasha, who usurped the Northern throne; grandson of Hezron (or mother of 1-4 above); a Benjamite, son of Ehud; one of David's heroes; a Levite during David's time; a chief man under Nehemiah
H281.description: Ahiah was a priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H282.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.27;; son of: Shelomi (H8015); § Ahihud = "brother of majesty"; a prince of Asher
H282.description: Ahihud, son of Shelomi, was a leader from the tribe of Asher appointed to help allocate the Promised Land.

H283.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.6.3;; son of: Abinadab (H0041);; brother of: Eleazar (H0499H) and Uzzah (H5798A); § Ahio = "brotherly" or "fraternal"; son of Abinadab who sheltered the ark; a Benjamite; another Benjamite of Saul's ancestry
H283.description: Ahio was a son of Elpaal and a descendant of Benjamin.

H284.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.7;; son of: Ehud (H0164);; brother of: Naaman (H5283J), Ahijah (H0281K), Gera (H1617J) and Uzza (H5798H); § Ahihud = "brother of mystery"; a Benjamite, son of Ehud
H284.description: Ahihud was a son of Ehud, a descendant of Benjamin.

H285.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.14.3;; son of: Phinehas (H6372H);; brother of: Ichabod (H0350);; father of: Ahimelech (H0288); § Ahitub = "my brother is good (goodness)"; a grandson of Eli; the father of Zadok the priest
H285.description: Ahitub, son of Amariah and father of Zadok, was an ancestor of Ezra the scribe in the priestly line.

H286.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.16;; father of: Jehoshaphat (H3092), Baana (H1195); § Ahilud = "child's brother"; father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder; father of Baana, an officer of Solomon
H286.description: Ahilud was the father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder, and Baana, one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

H287.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.25;; son of: Amasai (H6022);; father of: Elkanah (H0511J); also called Mahath at 1Ch.6.35;; Also named: ma.chat (מַ֫חַת "Mahath" H4287I); § Ahimoth = "brother of death" or "my brother is death"; a son of Elkanah, a Levite
H287.description: Ahimoth, also known as Mahath, was a Levite descended from Kohath, the son of Elkanah.

H288.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.14.3;; son of: Ahitub (H0285);; father of: Abiathar (H0054); also called Ahijah (KJV: Ahiah) at 1Sa.14.3,18;; Also named: a.chiy.yah (אֲחִיָּ֫הוּ "Ahijah" H0281O); § Ahimelech = "my brother is king" or "brother of Melek"; a priest murdered by Doeg at Saul's command, for supposedly assisting David; a Hittite warrior under David
H288.description: Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob, gave David consecrated bread and Goliath's sword but was later killed by Saul for aiding David.

H289.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.13.22;; son of: Anak (H6061);; brother of: Sheshai (H8344) and Talmai (H8526); § Ahiman = "my brother is a gift"; a son of Anak; a Levite servant in the temple
H289.description: Ahiman was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper during the reign of David.

H290.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.14.50;; father of: Ahinoam (H0293); § Ahimaaz = "my brother is anger (wrath)"; father-in-law of Saul; Zadok's son who aided David during Absalom's rebellion; a supply officer of Solomon
H290.description: Ahimaaz, who was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath, served as the governor of Naphtali during Solomon's reign.

H291.definition: A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.19;; son of: Shemida (H8061);; brother of: Shechem (H7928H), Likhi (H3949) and Aniam (H0593); § Ahian = "brotherly" or "fraternal"; son of Shemida of Manasseh
H291.description: Ahian was a son of Shemidah, a descendant of Manasseh.

H292.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.14;; son of: Iddo (H5714); § Ahinadab = "my brother is liberal, or, noble"; a supply officer of Solomon
H292.description: Ahinadab, the son of Iddo, was one of Solomon's twelve governors, responsible for providing provisions for the king's household.

H293.definition: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.14.50;; daughter of: Ahimaaz (H0290); married to Saul (H7586G);; mother of: Jonathan (H3083H), Abinadab (H0041H), Malchi-shua (H4444), Merab (H4764) and Michal (H4324); § Ahinoam = "my brother is delight"; wife of Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz; wife of David, mother of Amnon, a Jezreelitess
H293.description: Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz, was one of King Saul's wives.

H294.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.31.6;; father of: Oholiab (H0171); § Ahisamach = "my brother is support (has supported)"; a Danite, father of Aholiab, a workman on the tabernacle
H294.description: Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, was the father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan who helped construct the tabernacle.

H295.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.12;; son of: Ammishaddai (H5996); § Ahiezer = "my brother is help"; a Danite chief who assisted Moses; a Danite chief, one of David's heroes
H295.description: Ahiezer was a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

H296.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.22.12;; son of: Shaphan (H8227B);; brother of: Elasah (H0501J) and Gemariah (H1587H);; father of: Gedaliah (H1436B); § Ahikam = "my brother has risen (arisen)"; son of Shaphan, an officer in Josiah's reign; protector of Jeremiah; father of Gedaliah
H296.description: Ahikam, son of Shaphan, was an official during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim, and he protected Jeremiah from death.

H297.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.26.38;; son of: Benjamin (H1144);; brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714) and Jediael (H3043); Also named: a.chi.ra.mi (אֲחִירָמִי "Ahiramite" H0298); § Ahiram = "my brother is exalted" or "brother or (the) lofty"; a Benjamite, son of Benjamin
H297.description: Ahiram, also known as Aharah or Ehi, was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ahiramite clan.

H298.definition: Someone descended from Ahiram, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.26.38;; son of: Benjamin (H1144);; brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714) and Jediael (H3043); Group of a.chi.ram (אֲחִירָם "Ahiram" H0297); § Ahiramite = "brother of mother"; one of the clan of Ahiram

H299.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.15;; son of: Enan (H5881); § Ahira = "my brother is evil"; a chief of Naphtali
H299.description: Ahira, son of Enan, was the leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

H300.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.10;; son of: Bilhan (H1092H);; brother of: Jeush (H3266H), Benjamin (H1144H), Ehud (H0164H), Chenaanah (H3668H), Zethan (H2133) and Tarshish (H8659I); § Ahishahar = "my brother is dawn" or "brother of the dawn"; a Benjamite
H300.description: Ahishahar was a son of Bilhan and a descendant of Benjamin.

H301.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.6; § Ahishar = "my brother sang"; chief steward for Solomon
H301.description: Ahishar was in charge of King Solomon's palace.

H302.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.15.12;; father of: Eliam (H0463H); § Ahithophel = "my brother is foolish (folly)"; a counsellor of David, grandfather of Bathsheba (cf 2Sa 11:3, 23:34), who joined Absalom in revolt against David, and committed suicide when Absalom did not heed his counsel
H302.description: Ahithophel was a wise counselor to David who defected to Absalom's side during Absalom's rebellion, but later committed suicide when his advice was not followed.

H303.definition: Ahlab = "fertile place"; a town allotted to Asher, site presently unknown; Also named: che.vel (חֶ֫בֶל "Mahalab" H2256A)
H303.description: Ahlab (Mahalab), a city in Asher's territory, not conquered by the Israelites.

H304.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.31;; son of: Sheshan (H8348); married to Jarha (H3398);; father of: Attai (H6262); § Ahlai = "O! would that!"; daughter of Sheshan; father of one of David's heroes (mighty men, warriors)
H304.description: Ahlai was the father of Zabad, who was one of David's mighty men.

H305.definition: Oh that...!; oh would that!; ah that!

H306.definition: amethyst, a gem in the third row on the ephod, breastplate of judgment worn by the high priest. Transliteration of the Septuagint word. Identification is not certain but is a purple stone perhaps a corundum or red or brown jasper.

H307.definition: § Achmetha = "Ecbatana"; capital of Media, captured by Cyrus in 550 BC and then summer residence of Persian kings
H307.description: Ecbatana was a city in Media where a scroll was found containing a decree by King Cyrus (Ezra 6:2).

H308.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.34;; father of: Eliphelet (H0467H); § Ahasbai = "brother of my encompassers"; father of Eliphelet, one of David's heroes
H308.description: Ahasbai the Maachathite was the father of Eliphelet, one of David's mighty men.

H309.definition: to delay, hesitate, tarry, defer, remain behind ((Qal); to delay, tarry (intensive); to cause one to delay, hinder, keep back; (Piel) to delay, wait, stay behind (but not in hope)); Also means: ya.char (יָחַר "to delay" H3186)

senses.text: to delay, hesitate, tarry, defer, remain behind

children.text: to cause one to delay, hinder, keep back
(Piel) to delay, wait, stay behind (but not in hope)

H310.definition: after the following part, behind (of place), hinder, afterwards (of time) (as an adverb; behind (of place); afterwards (of time); as a preposition; behind, after (of place); after (of time); besides; as a conjunction; after that; as a substantive; hinder part; with other prepositions; from behind; from following after)

senses.text: after the following part, behind (of place), hinder, afterwards (of time)

H312.definition: another, other, following (following, further; other, different)

H313.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.12;; father of: Hushim (H2366); § Aher = "following"; a Benjamite
H313.description: Aher was a son of Shemer, a descendant of Asher.

H314.definition: behind, following, subsequent, western (behind, hindermost, western (of location); later, subsequent, latter, last (of time))

H315.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21;; son of: Benjamin (H1144);; brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Aharah at 1Ch.8.1;; Another name of e.chi (אֵחִי "Ehi" H0278); § Aharah = "a following brother"; a son of Benjamin

H316.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.8;; son of: Harum (H2037); § Aharhel = "a following host"; a descendant of Judah through Caleb
H316.description: Aharhel was a son of Harum, a descendant of Judah.

H317.definition: other, another; Aramaic of a.cher (אַחֵר "another" H0312)

H318.definition: end, outcome (hid part (of cows); end (of time); remnant, descendants)

H319.definition: after part, end (end, issue, event; latter time (prophetic for future time); posterity; last, hindermost); Aramaic equivalent: a.cha.rit (אַחֲרִית "latter" H0320)

H320.definition: end, latter; Aramaic of a.cha.rit (אַחֲרִית "end" H0319)

H321.definition: other, another; Aramaic of a.cher (אַחֵר "another" H0312)

H323.definition: satrap, a governor of a Persian province; Aramaic equivalent: a.chash.dar.pan (אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנִין "satrap" H0324)

H324.definition: satrap, a governor of a Persian province; Aramaic of a.chash.dar.pan (אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפַּן "satrap" H0323)

H325.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.4.6; married to Vashti (H2060);; father of: Darius (H1868H); § Ahasuerus = "I will be silent and poor"; title of the king of Persia, probably Xerxes
H325.description: Ahasuerus, Emperor of Persia (probably Xerxes I), chose Esther as his queen and issued decrees impacting the Jews.

H326.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.6;; son of: Ashhur (H0806) and Naarah (H5292B);; brother of: Ahuzzam (H0275), Hepher (H2660) and Temeni (H8488);; half-brother of: Zereth (H6889), Izhar (H3328), Ethnan (H0869) and Koz (H6976); § Haahashtari = "I will diligently observe the searching"; a descendant of Ashur of Judah
H326.description: Haahashtari was a descendant of Judah through Hezron, as listed in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H329.definition: Atad, a threshing floor; afterwards called Bethhogla was located on the west of Jordan between the Jordan and Jericho; Also named: a.vel mits.ra.yim (אָבֵל מִצְרַיִם "Abel-mizraim" H0067)
H329.description: Atad was a threshing floor near the Jordan River where the Egyptians mourned Jacob's death.

H331.definition: to shut, shut up, close ((Qal) to shut, stop (of lips); (Hiphil) of the wicked stopping their ears (fig.))

children.text: (Hiphil) of the wicked stopping their ears (fig.)

H332.definition: (Qal) shut (to shut up, close, bind; close one's mouth)

H333.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.16;; father of: Hezekiah (H2396I); § Ater = "binder"; an exiled relative of Hezekiah
H333.description: Ater was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity (Ezr.2.16; Neh.7.21).

H334.definition: bound, impeded (on the right, ie, left-handed), shut, shut up

H335.definition: whereto ?, whence?; which?, how? (in prefix with other adverb)

H340.definition: to be hostile to, to be an enemy to ((Qal); to be hostile to; to treat as an enemy)

senses.text: to be hostile to, to be an enemy to

H343.definition: distress, burden, calamity (burden (of the righteous); calamity (of nation); disaster (of wicked); day of calamity)

H345.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.24;; son of: Zibeon (H6649H);; brother of: Anah (H6034I); § Aiah or Ajah = "falcon"; a Horite, son of Zibeon; father of Rizpah, Saul's concubine
H345.description: Aiah was the father of Rizpah, who was a concubine of King Saul.

H347.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Job.1.1; Also named: Iōb (Ἰώβ "Job" G2492); § Job = "hated"; a patriarch, the subject of the book of Job
H347.description: Job, a blameless and upright man from Uz, endured severe trials and maintained his faith in God.

H348.definition: A queen of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.16.31;; daughter of: Ethbaal (H0856); married to Ahab (H0256);; mother of: Ahaziah (H0274) and Joram (H3141H); Also named: Iezabēl (Ἰεζαβήλ "Jezebel" G2403); § Jezebel = "Baal exalts" or "Baal is husband to" or "unchaste"; queen of Israel, wife of Ahab, daughter of Ethbaal
H348.description: Queen Jezebel, the Phoenician wife of King Ahab, promoted Baal worship and persecuted the prophets of God.

H350.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.4.21;; son of: Phinehas (H6372H);; brother of: Ahitub (H0285); § Ichabod = "no glory"; a son of Phinehas, so named because of the capture of the Ark by the Philistines
H350.description: Ichabod was the son of Phinehas, born when the ark of God was captured by the Philistines and named to reflect the departure of glory from Israel.

H352.definition: ram (ram (as food); ram (as sacrifice); ram (skin dyed red, for tabernacle))

H993.description: Betonim was a town allotted to the tribe of Gad in the region of Gilead.

H1004.description: Beth-ashbea was a place associated with the families of the house of Ashbea, who were known for their fine linen work. (1Ch.4.21)

H1006.description: Bajith (or "temple") was a Moabite temple or high place mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy against Moab. (Isaiah 15:2)

H1007.definition: § Beth-aven = "house of vanity"; a city east of Bethel
H1007.description: Beth-aven was a town and wilderness near Ai and Bethel, associated with idolatry and Israel's defeat.

H1008.definition: § Bethel = "house of God"; ancient place and seat of worship in Ephraim on border of Benjamin, identified with Luz (former name)
H1008.description: Bethel, also called Luz, was an important city in Israel, associated with the patriarchs Abraham and Jacob, later becoming a center of idolatry. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H1009.definition: § Beth-Arbel = "house of God's Ambush"; a place in Palestine, perhaps Gilead or Galilee
H1009.description: Beth-arbel was a place destroyed by Shalman, mentioned in Hosea's prophecy as an example of destruction. (Hosea 10:14)

H1010.definition: Beth-meon = "house of Meon"; a city in the territory of Reuben; Another name of ba.al me.on (בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן "Baal-meon" H1186)

H1011.definition: § Beth-birei = "house of a creative one"; a place in the territory of Simeon
H1011.description: Beth-biri was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon, formerly known as Bethul. (1Ch.4.31)

H1012.definition: Beth-barah = "house of (the) ford"; a place on the Jordan; Also named: Bēthabara (Βηθαβαρά,Βηθανία "Bethany" G0962)
H1012.description: Beth-barah (Bethabara) was a place where Gideon stationed men to intercept the fleeing Midianites, and where John the Baptist baptized.

H1013.definition: § Beth-gader = "house of the wall"; a place in Judah
H1013.description: Beth-gader was a town associated with the descendants of Hareph, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah. (1Ch.2.51)

H1014.definition: § Beth-gamul = "house of recompense"; a place in Moab
H1014.description: Beth-gamul was a Moabite town mentioned in Jeremiah's prophecy against Moab, likely destroyed or captured by the Babylonians. (Jeremiah 48:23)

H1015.definition: Beth-diblathaim = "house of the two fig-cakes"; a place in Moab; Another name of al.mon div.la.ta.ye.mah (עַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה "Almon-diblathaim" H5963)

H1016.definition: § Beth-dagon = "house of Dagon"; the temple of Dagon in Judah
H1016.description: Beth-dagon was a town in Judah, likely named after the Philistine god Dagon. (Joshua 15:41)

H1017.definition: Bethelite = "house of God"; an inhabitant of Bethel; Another name of bet-el (בֵּֽיתְ־אֵל "Bethel" H1008G)

H1018.definition: § Beth-ezel = "house of narrowing"; a place in Judah
H1018.description: Beth-ezel was a town mentioned in Micah's prophecy, where the inhabitants could not offer support or refuge during a time of judgment. (Micah 1:11)

H1019.definition: Beth-gilgal = "the house of the wheel"; a place in Palestine; Another name of gil.gal (גִּלְגָּל "Gilgal" H1537G)

H1020.definition: § Beth-jesimoth = "house of the desolation"; a place in Moab given to the tribe of Reuben
H1020.description: Beth-jeshimoth was a town in Moab, allotted to Reuben, near where the Israelites camped and mentioned in a prophecy against Moab.

H1021.definition: § Beth-haccerem = "house of the vineyard"; a place in Judah
H1021.description: Beth-haccherem was a town in Judah, possibly fortified, mentioned by Jeremiah as a place to raise a signal fire.

H1022.definition: Group of bet le.chem (בֵּית לֶ֫חֶם "Bethlehem" H1035); § Bethlehemite = "house of bread"; an inhabitant of Bethlehem

H1023.definition: Beth Ham-merchaq = "remote house"; house or settlement on the bank of Kidron
H1023.description: Beth-merchak was a place near Jerusalem where David stayed with his household during Absalom's revolt. (2Sa.15.17)

H1024.definition: Beth-marcaboth = "house of the chariots"; a place in Simeon; Another name of mad.man.nah (מַדְמַנָּה "Madmannah" H4089G)

H1025.definition: § Beth-emek = "house of the valley"; a place on the border of Asher
H1025.description: Beth-emek was a town in the territory of Asher, mentioned in the description of Asher's border. (Joshua 19:27)

H1026.definition: § Beth-arabah = "house of the desert valley" or "place of the depression"; a place in Judah or in Benjamin
H1026.description: Beth-arabah was a town and wilderness area allotted to Judah and Benjamin, and the Arbathite was a descendant of Abi-albon.

H1027.definition: Beth-aram = "place of the height"; a place in Gad; Also named: bet ha.ran (בֵּית הָרָן "Beth-haran" H1028)
H1027.description: Beth-haram (Beth-haran) was a town allotted to the tribe of Gad, east of the Jordan River, which they fortified.

H1028.definition: Beth-haran = "house of their mount: house of the joyful shouter"; a place in Gad, possibly "Beth Harran", one hour east of Jordan, opposite Jericho; Another name of bet ha.ram (בֵּית הָרָם "Beth-haram" H1027)

H1029.definition: § Beth-shittah = "house of the acacia tree" or "place of the acacia"; an unknown location, perhaps an acacia grove
H1029.description: Beth-shittah, a location near where the Midianites fled after being defeated by Gideon's army.

H1030.definition: Bethshemite or Beth-shemeshite = "house of the sun"; an inhabitant of Beth-shemesh; Another spelling of bet she.mesh (בֵּית שֶׁ֫מֶשׁ "Beth-shemesh" H1053)

H1031.definition: § Beth-hoglah = "house of the partridge" or "place of partridge"; a place in Benjamin on the border with Judah
H1031.description: Beth-hoglah was a town on the border between Judah and Benjamin, near the northern end of the Dead Sea. (Joshua 15:6; 18:19, 21)

H1032.definition: § Beth-horon = "house of hollowness"; two towns in Ephraim (Upper Beth-horon-town on the mountains of Ephraim; Lower Beth-horon-town located 800 feet (245 m) lower than Upper Beth-horon)

children.text: Upper Beth-horon-town on the mountains of Ephraim
Lower Beth-horon-town located 800 feet (245 m) lower than Upper Beth-horon

H1032.description: Lower Beth-horon was a town allotted to Ephraim and Dan, known for a battle where the sun stood still. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H1033.definition: § Beth-car = "house of the ram" or "place of the lamb"; a place apparently belonging to the Philistines
H1033.description: Beth-car was the place where the Israelites pursued the Philistines after the return of the Ark of the Covenant. (1Sa.7.11)

H1034.definition: § Beth-lebaoth = "house of lionesses"; a place in Simeon
H1034.description: Beth-lebaoth was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon, also known as Lebaoth. (Joshua 19:6)

H1035.definition: § Beth-lehem = "house of bread (food)"; a city in Judah, birthplace of David
H1035.description: Bethlehem, also called Ephrath or Ephrathah, was the city where David and Jesus were born, located in Judah. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H1036.definition: Bethel-aphrah = "house belonging to Aphrah" or "house to (i.e. of) dust"; a Philistine city; Another name of oph.rah (עׇפְרָה "Ophrah" H6084G)

H1037.definition: § Beth-millo = "house of Millo" or "house of the rampart"; a place near Shechem
H1037.description: Beth-millo was a fortified place in Shechem where the men of the city made Abimelech king, later becoming his enemies. (Judges 9:6, 20)

H1038.definition: Beth-maachah = "house of pressure"; a place in the northern kingdom; Combined with a.vel (אָבֵל "Abel" H0059H)

H1039.definition: Beth-Nimrah = "house of the leopard"; a place east of the Jordan in Gad; Also named: nim.rah (נִמְרָה "Nimrah" H5247)
H1039.description: Beth-nimrah (Nimrah) was a town allotted to the tribe of Gad, east of the Jordan River, which they built or fortified.

H1040.definition: § Beth-eden = "house of delight"; a city in Syria, modern Juseih (cuneiform = Bit Adini)
H1040.description: Beth-eden was a place associated with the rulers of Aram (Syria), mentioned in Amos's prophecy against Damascus. (Amo.1.5)

H1041.definition: Beth-azmaveth = "house of the strength of death"; a place near Jerusalem; Also named: az.ma.vet (עַזְמָ֫וֶת "Azmaveth" H5820K)
H1041.description: Beth-azmaveth (Azmaveth) was a town in Benjamin, home to some who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H1042.definition: § Beth-anoth = "house of responses (or afflictions)"; a place in Judah
H1042.description: Beth-anoth was a town in the hill country of Judah, mentioned in the list of cities and villages within Judah's inheritance. (Joshua 15:59)

H1043.definition: § Beth-anath = "house of response (or affliction)"; a place in Naphtali
H1043.description: Beth-anath was a Canaanite town allotted to the tribe of Naphtali, but the Naphtalites did not drive out its inhabitants.

H1044.definition: § Beth-eged = "house of binding" i.e. "shearing house"; a place in the northern kingdom

H1045.definition: Beth-ashtaroth = "house of Ashtaroth"; a Philistine temple
H1045.description: Beth-Ashtoreth was a Philistine city where Saul's armor was put in the temple of Ashtoreth after his death. (1Sa.31.10)

H1046.definition: § Beth-palet = "house of escape" or "place of escape"; a place in southern Judah
H1046.description: Beth-pelet was a town in southern Judah, allotted to Judah and later resettled by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile.

H1047.definition: § Beth-peor = "house of Peor"; a place east of the Jordan, in the land of the Amorites, allotted to the tribe of Reuben
H1047.description: Beth-peor was a place east of the Jordan River, where the Israelites camped and Moses was buried in an unknown valley.

H1048.definition: § Beth-pazzez = "house of dispersion"; a place in Issachar
H1048.description: Beth-pazzez, a town within the territory allotted to the tribe of Issachar.

H1049.definition: § Beth-zur = "house of the rock"; a place in Judah
H1049.description: Beth-zur was a town in the hill country of Judah, fortified by Rehoboam, later repaired by Nehemiah, and associated with Maon.

H1050.definition: Beth-rehob = "house of the street"; a place in Dan on road to Hamath; Also named: re.chov (רְחוֹב "Rehob" H7340K)
H1050.description: Beth-rehob (Rehob) was an Aramean city and region, allied with the Ammonites against David, located near the northern border of Israel.

H1051.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.12;; son of: Eshton (H0850);; brother of: Paseah (H6454) and Tehinnah (H8468); § Beth-rapha = "house of healing"; the son of Eshton

H1052.definition: § Beth-shean or Beth-Shan = "house of ease"; a place in Manasseh, west of the Jordan
H1052.description: Beth-shean (Beth-shan) was a city allotted to Manasseh, where the Philistines fastened Saul's body to the wall after his death. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H1053.definition: § Beth-shemesh = "house of the sun" or "sun-temple"; a town in southwest Judah
H1053.description: Beth-shemesh was a city allotted to Judah and the Levites, associated with the return of the Ark of the Covenant from the Philistines. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H1054.definition: § Beth-tappuah = "house of the apple" of "place of apples"; a town in Judah

H1075.description: Bichri, a Benjamite, was the father of Sheba, who led a rebellion against King David.

H1092.description: Bilhan, a Benjamite, was the son of Jediael and had seven sons who were heads of families.

H1106.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21;; son of: Benjamin (H1144);; brother of: Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043);; father of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265); Also named: bal.i (בַּלְעִי "Belaite" H1108); § Bela = "destruction"; a king of Edom; first son of Benjamin; a son of Ahaz, a Reubenite
H1106.description: Bela, a descendant of Reuben, was the son of Azaz

H1108.definition: Someone descended from Bela who was a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21;; son of: Benjamin (H1144);; brother of: Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043);; father of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265); Group of be.la (בֶּ֫לַע "Bela" H1106A); § Belaites = "swallowing"; descendants of Bela

H1109.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.22.5;; son of: Beor (H1160H); Also named: Balaam (Βαλαάμ "Balaam" G0903); § Balaam = "not of the people"; the son of Beor, a man endowed with the gift of prophecy
H1109.description: Balaam was a pagan prophet hired by Balak to curse Israel, but he blessed them instead.

H1110.definition: to waste, lay waste, devastate ((Poel) to make waste; (Pual) devastated (participle))

H1111.definition: A man of the Moabites living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.22.2;; son of: Zippor (H6834); Also named: Balak (Βαλάκ "Balak" G0904); § Balak = "devastator"; a king of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel
H1111.description: Balak, son of Zippor, was the king of Moab who tried to curse Israel through Balaam.

H1112.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Dan.5.1;; son of: Nebuchadnezzar (H5019); Also named: be.le.shats.tsar (בֵּֽלְאשַׁצַּר, בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר "Belshazzar" H1113); § Belshazzar = "Bel protect the king"; king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel interpreted the writing on the wall
H1112.description: Belshazzar, the last Emperor of Babylon, is mentioned in the book of Daniel as the son of Nebuchadnezzar (though historically known as the son of Nabonidus).

H1113.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Dan.5.1;; son of: Nebuchadnezzar (H5019); Aramaic of be.le.shats.tsar (בֵּֽלְאשַׁצַּר, בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר "Belshazzar" H1112); § Belshazzar = "Bel protect the king"; king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel interpreted the writing on the wall

H1114.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2; § Bilshan = "in slander"; an exile who returned with Zerubbabel
H1114.description: Bilshan was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H1115.definition: subst; not, except; adv; not; except (after preceding negation); conj; except (after an implied or expressed negation); with prep; so as not, in order not; an account of not, because...not; until not

H1116.definition: high place, ridge, height, bamah (technical name for cultic platform) (high place, mountain; high places, battlefields; high places (as places of worship); funeral mound?)

senses.text: high place, ridge, height, bamah (technical name for cultic platform)

H1117.definition: Bamah = "high place"; a place in Palestine (of places of idolatrous worship); Another name of giv.on (גִּבְעוֹן "Gibeon" H1391)

H1118.definition: A man of the tribe of Asher living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.33;; son of: Japhlet (H3310);; brother of: Pasach (H6457) and Ashvath (H6220); § Bimhal = "in circumcision: in weakness (by mixture)"; a descendant of Asher
H1118.description: Bimhal was a son of Japhlet, a descendant of Asher.

H1120.definition: § Bamoth = "high places" or "great high place"; a town on the river Arnon in Moab
H1120.description: Bamoth was an Israelite encampment in Moab during the Exodus. (Numbers 21:19-20)

H1121.description: Beno was a Levite from the family of Merari, son of Jaaziah.

H1122.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; § Ben = "son"; a Levite, one of the porters appointed by David for the ark
H1122.description: Ben, a Levite, was appointed as one of the gatekeepers for the ark during its transfer to Jerusalem.

H1123.definition: son, child; Aramaic of ben (בֵּן ": child" H1121)

H1124.definition: to build ((P'al) to build; (Ithp'il) to be built)

H1125.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.11;; son of: Abinadab (H0041J); married to Taphath (H2955); § Ben-Abinadab = "son of Abinadab"; an officer of Solomon
H1125.description: Ben-abinadab, Solomon's son-in-law, was one of the twelve officials appointed over Israel to provide food for the king and his household.

H1126.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18;; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354);; brother of: Joseph (H3130);; half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783);; father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x; Another name of bin.ya.min (בִּנְיָמִין "Benjamin" H1144G); § Ben-oni = "son of my sorrow"; the name given to Benjamin by Rachel

H1127.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.13;; son Geber (H1398); § Ben-geber = "the son of Geber" or "the son of a man"; an officer of Solomon
H1127.description: Ben-Geber was one of the twelve district governors appointed by Solomon, responsible for the region of Ramoth-gilead.

H1128.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.9;; son of: Deker (H1857); § Ben-dekar = "son of stabbing" or "son of Dekar"; an officer of Solomon
H1128.description: Ben-deker was one of the twelve district governors appointed by Solomon to provide provisions for the king and his household.

H1129.definition: to build, rebuild, establish, cause to continue ((Qal); to build, rebuild; to build a house (ie, establish a family); (Niphal); to be built; to be rebuilt; established (of restored exiles) (fig.); established (made permanent); to be built up (of childless wife becoming the mother of a family through the children of a concubine)); Aramaic equivalent: be.nah (בְּנָה "to build" H1124)

senses.text: to build, rebuild, establish, cause to continue

children.text: to build a house (ie, establish a family)
to be built up (of childless wife becoming the mother of a family through the children of a concubine)

H1130.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.15.18;; son of: Tabrimmon (H2886); § Ben-hadad = "son of [the false god] Hadad"; the king of Syria, contemporary with Asa of Judah; the son of Hazael, also king of Syria
H1130.description: Ben-hadad I, king of Aram, made a treaty with Asa of Judah and attacked Israel during the reign of Baasha.

H1131.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.10; also called Binnui at Neh.7.15;; Another spelling of ba.ni (בָּנִי "Bani" H1137Q); § Binnui = "built up"; an exile returnee with Zerubbabel, son of Henadad, who assisted at the reparation of the wall of Jerusalem, under Nehemiah; a Levite in time of Ezra, father of Noadiah; another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife; still another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife
H1131.description: Binnui, one of the descendants of Pahath-moab, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H1132.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.20;; son of: Ishi (H3469H);; brother of: Zoheth (H2105); § Ben-zoheth = "son of Zoheth"; one of the tribe of Judah
H1132.description: Ben-zoheth was a descendant of Judah through Ishi.

H1133.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.8;; son of: Hur (H1133H); § Ben-hur = "son of whiteness" or "son of Chur"; a man who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim
H1133.description: Ben-hur was one of Solomon's twelve officers over Israel.

H1134.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.17.7; § Ben-hail = "son of strength" or "son (man) of might"; a ruler (prince) under Jehoshaphat
H1134.description: Ben-hail, a Levite, was sent by Jehoshaphat to teach in Judah.

H1135.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.20;; son of: Shimon (H7889);; brother of: Amnon (H0550H), Rinnah (H7441) and Tilon (H8436); § Ben-hanan = "son of favour"; one of the tribe of Judah
H1135.description: Ben-hanan was a descendant of Judah through Shimon.

H1136.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.10;; son of: Hesed (H2618); § Ben-hesed = "son of mercy"; an officer of Solomon
H1136.description: Ben-hesed was one of Solomon's twelve officers over Israel.

H1137.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.36; § Bani = "built"; a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors; a Levite of the line of Merari, and forefather to Ethan; a man of Judah of the line of Pharez; "children of Bani" returned from captivity with Zerubbabel; one or up to three Levites in Nehemiah's time
H1137.description: Bani was a Levite who served as a musician during David's reign.

H1138.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.9.4; § Bunni = "built"; a Levite in the time of Nehemiah; another Levite of earlier date
H1138.description: Bunni was one of the leaders of the people who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

H1139.definition: § Bene-barak = "sons of lightning"; a city in Dan
H1139.description: Bene-berak was a town allotted to the tribe of Dan. (Joshua 19:45)

H1141.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.18;; son of: Jehoiada (H3077);; father of: Ammizabad (H5990); § Benaiah = "Jehovah has built" or "Yahweh has built up"; one of David's mighty warriors, son of Jehoiada the chief priest, a Levite, set by David over his bodyguard, later having remained faithful to Solomon during Adonijah's attempt on the crown, was raised into the place of Joab as commander-in-chief of the army; the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite, one of David's thirty mighty warriors, and the captain of the eleventh monthly course; a Simeonite, a prince of the families of Simeon; a Levite in the time of David who played with a psaltery on Alamoth; a priest in the time of David, appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark; a Levite of the sons of Asaph; a Levite in the time of Hezekiah; Four Israelites in the time of Ezra who had taken strange wives; the father of Pelatiah
H1141.description: Benaiah, a Levite, played the lyre and served as a gatekeeper during the transfer of the ark to Jerusalem.

H1142.definition: § Bene-jaakan = "sons of twisting"; an Israelite place of encampment in the wilderness (same as be.e.rot be.ne-ya.a.qan (בְּאֵרֹת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָן "Beeroth-bene-jaakan" H0885))
H1142.description: Bene-jaakan (Beeroth Bene-jaakan) was an Israelite encampment during the wilderness wanderings.

H1143.definition: between, space between two armies (man of the space between armies, i.e. champion (of Goliath) (meton))

children.text: man of the space between armies, i.e. champion (of Goliath) (meton)

H1144.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18;; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354);; brother of: Joseph (H3130);; half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783);; father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x; § Benjamin = "son of the right hand"; Jacob's and Rachel's youngest son, Joseph's full brother; son of Bilhan, great-grandson of Benjamin; a Benjamite, one of the sons of Harim, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife; the tribe descended from Benjamin, the son of Jacob
H1144.description: This Benjamin was a son of Bilhan and a descendant of Benjamin.

H1145.definition: Someone from the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18;; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354);; brother of: Joseph (H3130);; half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783);; father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x; Group of bin.ya.min (בִּנְיָמִין "Benjamin" H1144); § Benjamite = "a son of the right hand"; one of the tribe of Benjamin

H1146.definition: structure, building; Aramaic equivalent: bin.yan (בִּנְיָן "building" H1147)

H1147.definition: a building, structure; Aramaic of bin.yan (בִּנְיָן "building" H1146)

H1148.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.13; § Beninu = "our son"; a returning Levite exile who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
H1148.description: Beninu was a Levite who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's time.

H1150.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.8.37;; son of: Moza (H4162H);; father of: Raphah (H7498), Eleasah (H0501H) and Azel (H0682A); § Binea or Bineah = fountain; a descendant of Jonathan
H1150.description: Binea was a descendant of King Saul and his son Jonathan.

H1151.definition: A man of Ammon living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.19.38;; son of: Lot (H3876) and his second daughter (H3876I); half-brother of Moab (H4124H); § Ben-ami = "son of my people"; son of Lot, born to his second daughter, progenitor of the Ammonites
H1151.description: Ben-ammi was the son of Lot's younger daughter and the ancestor of the Ammonites.

H1152.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.6;; father of: Meshullam (H4918S); § Besodeiah = "with the counsel of Jehovah" or "in the secret of the Lord"; father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
H1152.description: Besodeiah was the father of Meshullam, who repaired the Old Gate of Jerusalem.

H1153.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.49; § Besai = "my treading"; a temple slave (or group of slaves) who returned with Zerubbabel
H1153.description: Besai was an ancestor of temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H1154.definition: unripe or sour grapes; Another spelling of bo.ser (בֹּ֫סֶר "unripe grape" H1155)

H1155.definition: unripe grapes, sour grapes; Also means: be.ser (בֶּסֶר "unripe grape" H1154)

H1156.definition: to ask, seek, request, desire, pray, make petition ((P'al); to ask, request; to seek (for favour))

senses.text: to ask, seek, request, desire, pray, make petition

H1157.definition: behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about (through (of action); behind (with verbs of shutting); about (with verbs of fencing); on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael))

senses.text: behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about

children.text: on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael)

H1158.definition: to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire ((Qal); to seek, enquire; to cause to boil up; (Niphal); to be searched out; to be swelling, bulging, swelling out)

senses.text: to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire

children.text: to be swelling, bulging, swelling out

H1159.definition: petition, request; prayer (always in Jewish liturgy)

H1160.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.32;; father of: Bela (H1106); § Beor = "burning"; father of Balaam; father of Bela, king of Edom
H1160.description: Beor was the father of Bela, an early Edomite king.

H1162.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Rut.2.1;; son of: Salmon (H8007) and Rahab (H7343); married to Ruth (H7327);; father of: Obed (H5744); Also named: Booz (Βοόζ "Boaz" G1003); § Boaz = "fleetness"; ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi; name of the left of two brazen pillars, 18 cubits high, erected in the porch of Solomon's temple
H1162.description: Boaz, a wealthy Bethlehemite, married Ruth and became an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

H1163.definition: to kick, kick at ((Qal); to kick; to kick at; to desire (fig.))

H1164.definition: ruin, heap of ruins; Another spelling of i (עִי "ruin" H5856)

H1166.definition: This name means to be married; Another name of ye.ru.sha.laim (יְרוּשָׁלִַ֫ם, יְרוּשְׁלֵם "Jerusalem" H3389)

H1167.definition: : master/leader; owner, husband, lord (owner; a husband; citizens, inhabitants; rulers, lords; (noun of relationship used to characterise-ie, master of dreams))

children.text: (noun of relationship used to characterise-ie, master of dreams)

H1168.definition: § Baal = "lord"; esp. lord, specif. as divine name, Baal; supreme male divinity of the Phoenicians or Canaanites
H1168.description: Baal was a descendant of Reuben, the firstborn son of Jacob.

H1169.definition: owner, lord; Aramaic of ba.al (בַּעַל ": master" H1167)

H1170.definition: § Baal-berith = "lord of the covenant"; a god of the Philistines
H1170.description: Baal, a Canaanite god of fertility and weather, and Peor, a Moabite god, were worshipped by the Israelites, leading them into idolatry and disobedience to the Lord.

H1171.definition: Baal-gad = "lord of fortune"; a city noted for Baal-worship, located at the most northern or northwestern point to which Joshua's victories extended; Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)

H1172.definition: mistress, female owner; sorceress, necromancer (noun of relationship)

H1173.description: Baalah was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon. (Joshua 15:29)

H1174.definition: Baal-hamon = "lord (possessor) of abundance"; the site of Solomon's vineyard; Another spelling of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)

H1175.definition: Baalath or Bealoth = "mistresses"; a town in south Judah; Another name of ba.a.lat be.er (בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר "Baalath-beer" H1192)

H1176.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.1.2; § Baal-zebub = "lord of the fly"; a Philistine deity worshipped at Ekron
H1176.description: Baal-zebub was the god of Ekron whom Ahaziah consulted about his illness.

H1177.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.38;; son of: Achbor (H5907); § Baal-hanan = "Baal is gracious"; an early king of Edom; one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations
H1177.description: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the lowlands under David's reign.

H1178.definition: § Baal-hazor = "lord of the village"; a town on the border between Ephraim and Benjamin, apparent location of a sheep farm of Absalom and location of Amnon's murder
H1178.description: Baal-hazor was the place where Absalom sheared his sheep. (2Sa.13.23)

H1179.definition: Baal-hermon or Baal-chermon = "lord of destruction"; a city near or on Mount Hermon, named as a seat of Baal worship; Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)

H1180.definition: Baali = "my lord"; a deity in the northern kingdom, variation of the name 'Baal'; Another name of ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068G)

H1181.definition: Baale-bamoth = "the lords of the high places"; the people of Arnon, east of Jordan

H1182.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.5.16;; son of: David (H1732);; brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); also called Beeliada at 1Ch.14.7;; Another name of el.ya.da (אֶלְיָדָע "Eliada" H0450G); § Beeliada = "the lord knows"; a son of David, born in Jerusalem, elsewhere named 'Eliada'

H1183.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.5; § Bealiah = "Jehovah is master"; a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag and was one of David's mighty warriors
H1183.description: Bealiah, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag.

H1185.definition: A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.40.14; § Baalis = "lord of the banner: in causing the joy"; king of the Ammonites at the time of the destruction of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar
H1185.description: Baalis, the king of the Ammonites, sent Ishmael to assassinate Gedaliah the governor.

H1186.definition: § Baal-meon = "lord of the habitation"; a town in Reuben, mentioned in connection with Nebo, and in the time of Ezekiel, Moabite
H1186.description: Baal-meon (Beth-baal-meon, Beth-meon, or Beon) was a Moabite town, allotted to Reuben, but later retaken by Moab.

H1187.definition: Baal-peor = "lord of the gap"; the deity worshipped at Peor with probable licentious rites; Another name of ba.al (בַּעַל "Baal" H1168A)

H1188.definition: § Baal-perazim = "lord of the breaks"; the site of a victory of David over the Philistines, and of a great destruction of their images; also called 'Mount Perazim'
H1188.description: Baal-perazim was the place where David defeated the Philistines. (2Sa.5.20; 1Ch.14.11)

H1189.definition: § Baal Tsphon or Baal-zephon = "lord of the north"; a place in Egypt near the Red Sea where Pharaoh and his army were destroyed during the Exodus
H1189.description: Baal-zephon was an Egyptian location where the Israelites camped before crossing the Red Sea.

H1190.definition: § Baal-shalisha = "thrice-great lord"; a place in Ephraim near Gilgal
H1190.description: Baal-shalishah was the place where a man brought provisions to Elisha. (2Ki.4.42)

H1191.description: Baalath was a town fortified by Solomon, possibly located in the Lebanon region. (1Ki.9.18; 2Ch.8.6)

H1192.definition: § Baalath-beer = "mistress of the well"; a town in the south part of Judah, given to Simeon, which also bore the name of 'Ramath-negeb'
H1192.description: Baalath-beer (Bealoth, Baal, or Ramoth) was a town in the Negev, allotted to Simeon.

H1193.definition: § Baal-tamar = "lord of the palms"; a place near Gibeah in Benjamin
