H3029.definition: (Aphel) to praise, give thanks; Aramaic of ya.dah (יָדָה "to give thanks" H3034)

H3030.definition: § Idalah = "memorial of God"; a town in Zebulun between Shimron and Bethlehem
H3030.description: Idalah, a town in the territory of Zebulun (Joshua 19:15).

H3031.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.3;; son of: Hur (H2354);; brother of: Uri (H0221), Shobal (H7732H), Salma (H8007H), Hareph (H2780), Jezreel (H3157J), Ishma (H3457), Hazzelelponi (H6753), Penuel (H6439H) and Ezer (H5829); § Idbash = "stout"; one of the 3 sons of Abi-etam, a descendant of Judah
H3031.description: Idbash was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

H3032.definition: v; (Qal) to throw lots, cast lots; n; love, loving-one, friend

H3033.definition: one dearly loved, beloved one, object of love

H3034.definition: to throw, shoot, cast ((Qal) to shoot (arrows); (Piel) to cast, cast down, throw down; (Hiphil); to give thanks, laud, praise; to confess, confess (the name of God); (Hithpael); to confess (sin); to give thanks); Aramaic equivalent: ye.da (יְדָא "to praise" H3029)

children.text: (Piel) to cast, cast down, throw down
to confess, confess (the name of God)

H3035.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.21;; son of: Zechariah (H2148); § Iddo = "timely" or "lovely"; son of Zechariah, ruler of the tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan in the time of David; a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
H3035.description: Iddo, the son of Zechariah, was a leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during King David's reign.

H3036.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.7; § Jadon = "thankful"; a Meronothite and one of the builders of the walls of Jerusalem
H3036.description: Jadon the Meronothite was one of the people who helped repair the walls of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H3037.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.21; § Jaddua = "knowing"; one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; son and successor in the high priesthood of Jonathan, Jeshua, or Johanan; the last of the high priests mentioned in the OT, probably living in the time of Alexander the Great
H3037.description: Jaddua was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant made by the people of Israel during Nehemiah's time.

H3038.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.44;; son of: Kishi (H7029);; father of: Obed-edom (H5654), Mattithiah (H4993H), Gedaliah (H1436I), Zeri (H6874), Jeshaiah (H3470H), Hashabiah (H2811I), Shemaiah (H8098K) and Uzziel (H5816K); also called Ethan at 1Ch.6.44; 15.17,19;; Also named: e.tan (אֵיתָן "Ethan" H0387J); § Jeduthun = "praising"; a Levite of the family of Merari and the chief of one of the 3 choirs of the temple whose descendants also formed one of the perpetual temple choirs; he is named at the beginning of 3 Psalms (Ps 39:1; 62:1; 77: either as the composer or the recipient of those Psalms but most likely as the leader of the choir by which those Psalms were to be sung
H3038.description: Jeduthun, also known as Ethan, was a Levitical musician and singer during the reign of King David.

H3040.definition: A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.22.1;; daughter of: Adaiah (H5718); married to Amon (H0526H);; mother of: Josiah (H2977); § Jedidah = "beloved"; the wife of king Amon and mother of king Josiah
H3040.description: Jedidah was the mother of King Josiah of Judah and the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

H3041.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.5.14;; son of: David (H1732) and Bathsheba (H1339);; brother of: Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727) and Nathan (H5416);; half-brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliada (H0450), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); married to daughter_of_Pharaoh (H6547P) and Naamah (H5279A);; father of: Taphath (H2955), Basemath (H1315) and Rehoboam (H7346); also called Jedidiah at 2Sa.12.25;; Another name of she.lo.moh (שְׁלֹמֹה "Solomon" H8010); § Jedidiah = "beloved of Jehovah"; the name given to Solomon through Nathan the prophet

H3042.definition: A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.37;; son of: Shimri (H8113);; father of: Allon (H0438H); § Jedaiah = "praised of Jehovah"; a Simeonite, forefather of Ziza; son of Harumaph and one who took part in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem
H3042.description: Jedaiah was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in a genealogy.

H3043.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.7.6;; son of: Benjamin (H1144);; brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714) and Ahiram (H0297);; father of: Bilhan (H1092H); § Jediael = "God makes known"; a chief patriarch of the tribe of Benjamin; maybe the same as 'Ashbel'; the 2nd son of Meshelemiahand a Korahite gatekeeper; son of Shimri and one of David's mighty warriors; one of the chiefs of the thousands of Manasseh who joined David on his march to Ziklag; maybe the same man as 3 above
H3043.description: Jediael the son of Shimri was one of David's mighty men from the tribe of Manasseh.

H3044.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.22.22;; son of: Nahor (H5152H) and Milcah (H4435);; brother of: Uz (H5780H), Buz (H0938), Kemuel (H7055), Chesed (H3777), Hazo (H2375), Pildash (H6394) and Bethuel (H1328A);; half-brother of: Tebah (H2875), Gaham (H1514), Tahash (H8477) and Maacah (H4601); § Jidlaph = "weeping"; a son of Nahor
H3044.description: Jidlaph, a son of Nahor and Milcah, was Abraham's nephew.

H3045.definition: to know ((Qal); to know (to know, learn to know; to perceive; to perceive and see, find out and discern; to discriminate, distinguish; to know by experience; to recognise, admit, acknowledge, confess; to consider); to know, be acquainted with; to know (a person carnally); to know how, be skilful in; to have knowledge, be wise; (Niphal); to be made known, be or become known, be revealed; to make oneself known; to be perceived; to be instructed; (Piel) to cause to know; (Poal) to cause to know; (Pual); to be known; known, one known, acquaintance (participle); (Hiphil) to make known, declare; (Hophal) to be made known; (Hithpael) to make oneself known, reveal oneself); Aramaic equivalent: ye.da (יְדַע "to know" H3046)

children.text: to perceive and see, find out and discern
to know how, be skilful in
to be made known, be or become known, be revealed
(Hithpael) to make oneself known, reveal oneself

H3046.definition: to know ((P'al) to know; (Aphel) to let someone know, communicate, inform, cause to know)

children.text: (Aphel) to let someone know, communicate, inform, cause to know

H3047.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.28;; son of: Onam (H0208H);; brother of: Shammai (H8060);; father of: Jether (H3500I) and Jonathan (H3129); § Jada = "He knows"; a Judahite, son of Onam and brother of Shammai, in the genealogy of the sons of Jerahmeel by his wife Atarah
H3047.description: Jada was the son of Onam and the brother of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah.

H3048.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi  living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.10;; son of: Joiarib (H3114); § Jedaiah = "Jehovah has known"; a priest in Jerusalem; a man who returned with Zerubbabel; a ruler of the priests in the days of Jeshua; a post exilic priest; one honoured by Jehovah, perhaps one of the above
H3048.description: Jedaiah was the head of the second priestly division during King David's reign and his descendants returned from the Babylonian exile.

H3049.definition: a knower, one who has a familiar spirit (a familiar spirit, soothsayer, necromancer (meton))

senses.text: a knower, one who has a familiar spirit

H3050.definition: A shortened form of the  name  ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068); used in many compounds as  the letters 'Je'  or 'jah'

H3051.definition: to give, provide, ascribe, come ((Qal); to give; to set, place; to provide (with reflexive); to ascribe (glory); to grant, permit, come now); Aramaic equivalent: ye.hav (יְהַב "to give" H3052)

H3052.definition: to give, provide ((P'al); to give; to place, lay (foundations); (Hithp'al); to be given; to be paid)

H3054.definition: (Hithpael) to become a Jew (in fact or in fraud), become Judaised

H3055.definition: § Jehud = "beauty"; a town in Dan, located between Baalath and Bene-berak and 8 miles east of Joppa
H3055.description: Jehud, a town allotted to the tribe of Dan (Joshua 19:45).

H3056.definition: A woman of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.47;; wife of: Caleb (H3612H);; mother of: Regem (H7276), Jotham (H3147I), Geshan (H1529), Pelet (H6404), Ephah (H5891I) and Shaaph (H8174); § Jahdai "whom he will place"; one of the family of Caleb
H3056.description: Jahdai was one of the descendants of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

H3057.definition: A woman of the tribe of Judah, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.18; married to Mered (H4778)(?);; mother of: Jered (H3382H), Heber (H2268I) and Jekuthiel (H3354); § adj f; the Jewess; Jehudijah = Jewess; (CLBL) a Calebite, the wife of one named Ezra
H3057.description: Jehudijah (or the Judahite) was the wife of Mered and the mother of Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel, as recorded in the genealogy of Judah.

H3058.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.16.1;; son of: Hanani (H2607); § Jehu = "Jehovah is He"; the king of the northern kingdom Israel who overthrew the dynasty of Omri; son of Hanani and an Israelite prophet in the time of Baasha and Jehoshaphat; the Antothite, a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors; a descendant of Judah of the house of Hezron; son of Josibiah and a chief of the tribe of Simeon
H3058.description: Jehu was one of the Benjamite archers and slingers who joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

H3059.definition: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.10.35;; son of: Jehu (H3058H);; father of: Joash (H3101J); also called Joahaz at 2Ki.14.1;; Also named: yo.a.chaz (יוֹאָחָז "Joahaz" H3099H); § Jehoahaz = "Jehovah has seized"; a king of Judah and son of Josiah; a king of the northern kingdom of Israel and son of Jehu; a king of Judah and son of Jehoram (Ahaziah)
H3059.description: Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, was king of Israel and reigned for seventeen years.

H3060.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.11.2;; son of: Ahaziah (H0274H) and Zibiah (H6645); married to Jehoaddan (H3086);; father of: Amaziah (H0558); also called Jehoash at 2Ki.11.21; 12.1,2,4,6,7,18; 14.13b;; Another name of yo.ash (יוֹאָשׁ "Joash" H3101I); § Jehoash = "given by the Lord"; son of king Ahaziah and the 8th king of Judah; son of king Jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of Israel

H3061.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah  living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.29.35;; son of: Israel (H3478) and Leah (H3812);; brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783);; half-brother of: Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Joseph (H3130) and Benjamin (H1144); married to Bath-shua (H1323I) and Tamar (H8559);; father of: Er (H6147), Onan (H0209), Shelah (H7956), Perez (H6557) and Zerah (H2226I); Aramaic of ye.hu.dah (יְהוּדָה "Judah" H3063); Judah-the territory of the tribe of Judah

H3062.definition: Someone descended from Judah (H3063) and possibly other tribes, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.25; Aramaic of ye.hu.di (יְהוּדִי "Jew" H3064)

H3063.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah  living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.29.35;; son of: Israel (H3478) and Leah (H3812);; brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783);; half-brother of: Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Joseph (H3130) and Benjamin (H1144); married to Bath-shua (H1323I) and Tamar (H8559);; father of: Er (H6147), Onan (H0209), Shelah (H7956), Perez (H6557) and Zerah (H2226I); § Judah = "praised"; the son of Jacob by Leah; the tribe descended from Judah the son of Jacob; the territory occupied by the tribe of Judah; the kingdom comprised of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin which occupied the southern part of Canaan after the nation split upon the death of Solomon; a Levite in Ezra's time; an overseer of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; a Levite musician in the time of Nehemiah; a priest in the time of Nehemiah
H3063.description: Judah was one of the Levites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

H3064.definition: Someone descended from Judah (H3063) and possibly other tribes, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.25; § Jew

H3065.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Jer.36.14;; son of: Nethaniah (H5418J); § Jehudi = "Jew"; son of Nethaniah and servant of king Jehoiakim
H3065.description: Jehudi was an official during King Jehoiakim's reign who read Jeremiah's scroll to the king, who then burned it piece by piece.

H3066.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah  living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.29.35;; son of: Israel (H3478) and Leah (H3812);; brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783);; half-brother of: Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Joseph (H3130) and Benjamin (H1144); married to Bath-shua (H1323I) and Tamar (H8559);; father of: Er (H6147), Onan (H0209), Shelah (H7956), Perez (H6557) and Zerah (H2226I); Another spelling of ye.hu.dah (יְהוּדָה "Judah" H3063); § in the Jewish language, in Hebrew
H3066.description: Hebrew was the language spoken by the Jews, as evidenced by its use in communication and writings (2Ki.18.26; 2Ch.32.18; Neh.13.24; Isa.36.11, 13).

H3067.definition: A woman living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.26.34;; daughter of: Beeri (H0882); married to Esau (H6215); § Judith = "Jewess" or "praised"; the daughter of Beeri the Hittite and wife of Esau
H3067.description: Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, was one of Esau's wives, causing grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

H3068.definition: Jehovah = "the existing One"; the proper name of the one true God (unpronounced except with the vowel pointings of a.do.na (אֲדֹנָי "Lord" H0136))

senses.text: the proper name of the one true God

children.text: unpronounced except with the vowel pointings of a.do.na (אֲדֹנָי "Lord" H0136)

H3068.description: Throughout the Bible, God is referred to by various names and titles, each revealing different aspects of His character, nature, and relationship with His people.

H3069.definition: Jehovah-used primarily in the combination 'Lord Jehovah' (equal to ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068) but pointed with the vowels of e.lo.him (אֱלֹהִים "God" H0430))

senses.text: Jehovah-used primarily in the combination 'Lord Jehovah'

children.text: equal to ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068) but pointed with the vowels of e.lo.him (אֱלֹהִים "God" H0430)

H3070.definition: Jehovah-jireh = "Jehovah sees"; symbolic name given by Abraham to Mount Moriah in commemoration of the interposition of the angel of Jehovah who prevented the sacrifice of Isaac and provided a substitute; Another name of ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068G)

H3071.definition: Jehovah-nissi = "Jehovah is my banner"; the name given by Moses to the altar which he built in commemoration of the discomfiture of the Amalekites

H3072.definition: Jehovah is our righteousness; a sacred name symbolically applied to Jerusalem and the Messiah

H3073.definition: Jehovah-shalom = "Jehovah is peace"; the name of a sacred altar built by Gideon in Ophrah

H3074.definition: Jehovah-shammah = "Jehovah is there"; a symbolic name for Jerusalem

H3075.definition: A man of the Moabites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.12.21;; son of: Shomer (H7763); § Jehozabad = "Jehovah has endowed"; son of Shomer, a Moabitish woman, who murdered Joash, king of Judah; a Benjamite, captain of 180,000 armed men, in the days of Jehoshaphat; a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David
H3075.description: Jehozabad was one of the sons of Obed-edom who served as a gatekeeper for the ark of the covenant.

H3076.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.4; § Jehohanan = "Jehovah has graced"; a priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim who returned with Zerubbabel; a high priest in the time of Ezra; a Levite priest who took part in the dedication of the wall in the time of Nehemiah; son of Tobiah; a Korhite Levite and one of the doorkeepers to the tabernacle in the time of David; a captain of Judah under king Jehoshaphat; an Ephraimite; an Israelite with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; a Jewish captain after the fall of Jerusalem; the eldest son of king Josiah; a post-exilic prince of the line of David; father of Azariah, priest in Solomon's time; a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors; a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors; a returning exile
H3076.description: Jehohanan was a Levite gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

H3077.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.18;; father of: Benaiah (H1141); § Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"; father of Benaiah, David's mighty warrior; leader of the priests who joined David at Hebron; high priest at the time of Athaliah's usurpation of the throne of Judah; hid Joash, the king's son, for six years and eventually replaced him on the throne of Judah; second priest, or sagan, to Seraiah the high priest
H3077.description: Jehoiada, the son of Benaiah, succeeded Ahithophel as King David's counselor.

H3078.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.24.6;; son of: Jehoiakim (H3079) and Nehushta (H5179);; father of: Zedekiah (H6667I)(?) and Shealtiel (H7597A); also called Jeconiah at 1Ch.3.16,17; 2x27.20; 28.4; 29.2;  Coniah at Jer.22.24,28; 37.1; Shallum at Jer.22.11; Jechoniah (KJV: Jechonias; NIV: Jeconiah) inMat.1.11; 1x; § Jehoiachin = "Jehovah establishes"; king of Judah, son of Jehoiakim, and the next to last king of Judah before the Babylonian captivity; kingship lasted for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar who took him to Babylon and imprisoned him for 36 years when he was finally released
H3078.description: Jehoiachin, also known as Jeconiah, Coniah, or Shallum, was a king of Judah who reigned for three months before being exiled to Babylon.

H3079.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.23.34;; son of: Josiah (H2977) and Zebidah (H2080);; half-brother of: Jehoahaz (H3059H), Zedekiah (H6667H) and Shallum (H7967J); married to Nehushta (H5179);; father of: Jehoiachin (H3078); also called Zedekiah at Jer.27.1;  Eliakim at 2Ki.23.34; 1x; Also named: el.ya.qim (אֶלְיָקִים "Eliakim" H0471I); § Jehoiakim = "Jehovah raises up"; son of Josiah and the third from the last king of Judah; subject vassel of Nebuchadnezzar who reigned for 11 years before he died a violent death either in combat or by the hands of his own subjects
H3079.description: Jehoiakim, also known as Eliakim, was a king of Judah who reigned for eleven years before being succeeded by his son Jehoiachin.

H3080.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.7; § Jehoiarib = "Jehovah contends"; A priest in Jerusalem; the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time
H3080.description: Jehoiarib was the head of the first priestly division organized by King David.

H3081.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Jer.37.3;; son of: Shelemiah (H8018M); also called Jucal (NIV: Jehukal) at Jer.38.1;; Also named: yu.khal (יוּכַל "Jucal" H3116); § Jehucal = "Jehovah is able"; a son of Shelemiah and a servant of king Zedekiah whom he sent to Jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice
H3081.description: Jehucal (or Jucal) was an official during King Zedekiah's reign who opposed the prophet Jeremiah and sought his punishment.

H3082.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.10.15;; son of: Rechab (H7394H); also called Jehonadab at 2Ki.10.15,23;; Also named: yo.na.dav (יוֹנָדָב "Jonadab" H3122H); § Jehonadab = "Jehovah is willing"; a son of Rechab, chief of the Rechabites, in the time of Jehu and Ahab; a nephew of David
H3082.description: Jonadab, the son of Rechab, instructed his descendants to abstain from wine, live in tents, and follow a nomadic lifestyle, which they faithfully observed.

H3083.definition: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at Jdg.18.30;; son of: Gershom (H1647)(?); § Jonathan or Jehonathan = "Jehovah has given"; a son of king Saul and a friend of David; a son of the high priest Abiathar and the last descendant of Eli of whom we hear; a nephew of David who like David slew a giant of Gath; an uncle of David; one of David's mighty warriors; one of David's treasurers; a scribe in the time of Jeremiah; a Levite and father of Zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall; a son or descendant of Gershom, the son of Moses, and a priest to the tribe of Dan; a son of Kareah and a brother of Johanan; a Judaite captain after the fall of Jerusalem; another Judaite father of Peleth; father of Ebed in the time of Ezra; son of Asahel in the time of Ezra; a priest of the family of Melicu in the time of Nehemiah; son of Joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of Nehemiah
H3083.description: Jehonathan was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

H3084.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.30.24;; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354);; brother of: Benjamin (H1144);; half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); married to Asenath (H0621);; father of: Manasseh (H4519) and Ephraim (H0669); also called Zaphenath-paneah at Gen.41.45;; Another name of yo.seph (יוֹסֵף "Joseph" H3130G); § Joseph = "Jehovah has added"; the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel

H3085.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.8.36;; son of: Ahaz (H0271H);; father of: Alemeth (H5964I), Azmaveth (H5820H) and Zimri (H2174H); also called Jarah at 1Ch.9.42;; Also named: ya.rah (יַעְרָה "Jarah" H3294); § Jehoadah = "Jehovah has adorned"; a descendant of Saul through Jonathan
H3085.description: Jehoaddah, also known as Jarah, was a descendant of King Saul mentioned in the genealogies of Benjamin.

H3086.definition: A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.14.2; married to Joash (H3101I);; mother of: Amaziah (H0558); also called Jehoaddin at 2Ki.14.2;; § Jehoaddan = "Jehovah delights"; wife of king Joash and mother of king Amaziah of Judah
H3086.description: Jehoaddan was the mother of King Amaziah of Judah and was from Jerusalem.

H3087.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.14;; son of: Seraiah (H8304H);; brother of: Ezra (H5830);; father of: Joshua (H3091J); also called Jozadak at Ezr.3.2,8; 5.2; 1x; § Jehozadak or Josedech = "Jehovah is righteous"; grandson of the high priest Hilkiah; son of the high priest Seraiah; and father of the high priest Joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar
H3087.description: Jehozadak (or Jozadak) was the father of Joshua, the high priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and helped rebuild the temple.

H3088.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.50;; son of: Jehoshaphat (H3092I);; brother of: Azariah (H5838Q), Jehiel (H3171J), Zechariah (H2148J), Azariahu (H5838R), Michael (H4317O) and Shephatiah (H8203K); married to Athaliah (H6271);; father of: Ahaziah (H0274H) and Jehosheba (H3089); also called Joram at 2Ki.8.21,23,24; 11.2; 2x; § Jehoram or Joram = "Jehovah is exalted"; son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and himself king of Judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked Athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of Judah to the worship of Baal; son of king Ahab of the northern kingdom of Israel and king of Israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by Jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered Naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of Elijah to the very letter; a priest in the reign of Jehoshaphat
H3088.description: Jehoram, also known as Joram, was the son of Jehoshaphat and king of Judah.

H3089.definition: A woman of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.11.2;; daughter of: Jehoram (H3088) and Athaliah (H6271);; sister of: Ahaziah (H0274H); married to Jehoiada (H3077H); also called Jehoshabeath at 2Ch.22.11;; Also named: ye.ho.shav.at (יְהוֹשַׁבְעַת "Jehoshabeath" H3090); § Jehosheba = "Jehovah has sworn"; daughter of king Joram of Judah and wife of the high priest Jehoiada (alternate spelling 'Jehoshabeath' - ye.ho.shav.at (יְהוֹשַׁבְעַת "Jehoshabeath" H3090))

senses.text: A woman of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.11.2;
sister of: Ahaziah (H0274H); married to Jehoiada (H3077H); also called Jehoshabeath at 2Ch.22.11;
daughter of king Joram of Judah and wife of the high priest Jehoiada

H3089.description: Jehosheba, also known as Jehoshabeath, was the daughter of King Jehoram and the wife of Jehoiada the priest; she saved the infant Joash from Athaliah's massacre of the royal family.

H3090.definition: A woman of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.11.2;; daughter of: Jehoram (H3088) and Athaliah (H6271);; sister of: Ahaziah (H0274H); married to Jehoiada (H3077H); also called Jehoshabeath at 2Ch.22.11;; Another name of ye.ho.she.va (יְהוֹשֶׁבַע "Jehosheba" H3089); § Jehoshabeath = "Jehovah is an oath"; daughter of king Joram of Judah and wife of the high priest Jehoiada (alternate spelling 'Jehosheba- ye.ho.she.va (יְהוֹשֶׁבַע "Jehosheba" H3089))

senses.text: A woman of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.11.2;
sister of: Ahaziah (H0274H); married to Jehoiada (H3077H); also called Jehoshabeath at 2Ch.22.11;
daughter of king Joram of Judah and wife of the high priest Jehoiada

H3091.definition: A man of the tribe of Ephraim living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness and Israel before the Monarchy, first mentioned at Exo.17.9;; son of: Nun (H5126); also called Hoshea (KJV: Oshea) at Num.13.8;  Jeshua at Neh.8.17;; § Joshua or Jehoshua = "Jehovah is salvation"; son of Nun of the tribe of Ephraim and successor to Moses as the leader of the children of Israel; led the conquest of Canaan; a resident of Beth-shemesh on whose land the Ark of the Covenant came to a stop after the Philistines returned it; son of Jehozadak and high priest after the restoration; governor of Jerusalem under king Josiah who gave his name to a gate of the city of Jerusalem
H3091.description: The ark of the covenant was placed on a rock in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.

H3092.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.16;; son of: Ahilud (H0286);; brother of: Baana (H1195); § Jehoshaphat = "Jehovah has judged"; son of king Asa and himself king of Judah for 25 years; one of the best, most pious, and prosperous kings of Judah; son of Nimshi and father of king Jehu of the northern kingdom of Israel; son of Ahilud and chronicler under David and Solomon; son of Paruah and one of the 12 commissary officers under Solomon; a priest and trumpeter in the time of David; symbolical name of a valley near Jerusalem which is the place of ultimate judgment; maybe the deep ravine which separates Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives through which the Kidron flowed
H3092.description: Jehoshaphat was the son of Asa and became a powerful and righteous king of Judah.

H3094.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.16;; father of: Ziph (H2128J), Ziphah (H2129), Tiria (H8493), Asarel (H0840); § Jehaleleel or Jehalelel = "God is praised"; a Calebite descendant of Judah; father of Azariah and a Merarite Levite in the time of Hezekiah
H3094.description: Jehallelel was a son of Elah and a descendant of Judah.

H3095.definition: a precious stone (known for its hardness) (perhaps the jasper, onyx, or diamond)

senses.text: a precious stone (known for its hardness)

children.text: perhaps the jasper, onyx, or diamond

H3096.definition: § Jahaz or Jahazah or Jahzah = "trodden down"; a place in Reuben east of the Dead Sea where Israel defeated Sihon king of the Amorites; site uncertain
H3096.description: Jahaz (Jahzah), a Moabite town where the Israelites defeated Sihon and later allotted to Reuben.

H3097.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.26.6; his mother was Zeruiah (H6870);; brother of: Abishai (H0052) and Asahel (H6214); § Joab = "Jehovah is father"; son of David's sister Zeruiah and general of David's army; a Judaite descendant of Kenaz; a post exilic family
H3097.description: Joab, the son of Seraiah, was the  father (ie founder) of Ge-harashim.

H3098.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.18.18;; son of: Asaph (H0623); § Joah = "Jehovah is brother"; son of Asaph and chronicler to Hezekiah; a Gershonite son or grandson of Zimmah; a Korhite, 3rd son of Obed-edom and doorkeeper in the time of David; son of Joahaz and chronicler to king Josiah
H3098.description: Joah, a son of Obed-edom, was one of the gatekeepers assigned to guard the temple.

H3099.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.34.8;; father of: Joah (H3098J); § Joahaz or Jehoahaz = "Jehovah has grasped"; the father of Joah, Josiah's chronicler
H3099.description: Joahaz was the father of Joah, who served as King Josiah's secretary during the temple repairs.

H3100.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.8.2;; son of: Samuel (H8050);; brother of: Abijah (H0029);; father of: Heman (H1968I); also translated "second" at 1Ch.6.28;; Also named: vash.ni (וַשְׁנִי "`second`" H2059); § Joel = "Jehovah is God"; son of Pethuel and the 2nd of the 12 minor prophets with a book by his name; probably prophesied in the time of king Uzziah of Judah; eldest son of Samuel the prophet and father of Heman the singer; a Simeonite chief; a Reubenite; a chief of Gad; son of Izrahiah and a chief of Issachar; brother of Nathan of Zobah and one of David's mighty warriors; son of Pedaiah and a chief of the half tribe of Manasseh west of the Jordan in the time of David; a son of Nebo who returned with Ezra and had a foreign wife; a Benjamite, son of Zichri; a Levite; a Kohathite Levite in the reign of Hezekiah; a Gershonite Levite chief in the time of David; a Gershonite Levite, son of Jehiel and a descendant of Laadan; maybe same as 13
H3100.description: Joel, the brother of Nathan, was one of the mighty men who fought valiantly for King David.

H3101.definition: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.6.11;; father of: Gideon (H1439); § Joash = "given by the Lord"; son of king Ahaziah and the 8th king of Judah; son of king Jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of Israel; father of Gideon; a son of king Ahab; a descendant of Shelah the son of Judah; either the son of Shelah or the son of Jokim; son of Shemaah of Gibeah who resorted to David at Ziklag
H3101.description: Joash, the son of Shemaah the Gibeathite, was a Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

H3102.definition: A man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.13;; son of: Issachar (H3485);; brother of: Tola (H8439), Puah (H6312) and Shimron (H8110B); also called Yob (KJV: Job) at Gen.46.13;; Another name of ya.shuv (יָשׁוּב "Jashub" H3437H); § Job = "persecuted"; the 3rd son of Issachar also called 'Jashub'

H3103.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.29;; son of: Joktan (H3355);; brother of: Almodad (H0486), Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Uzal (H0187), Diklah (H1853), Obal (H5745), Abimael (H0039), Sheba (H7614H), Ophir (H0211) and Havilah (H2341I); § Jobab = "a desert"; the last in order of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem; one of the kings of Edom; the king of Madon, located in northern Canaan, and one of the kings who opposed Joshua during the conquest and who were routed at Meron; head of a Benjamite house; another Benjamite
H3103.description: Jobab, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the sons of Elpaal.

H3104.definition: ram, ram's horn, trumpet, cornet (ram (only in combination); ram's horn, trumpet; jubilee year (marked by the blowing of cornets) (meton))

children.text: jubilee year (marked by the blowing of cornets) (meton)

H3106.definition: A man living at the time before the Flood, only mentioned at Gen.4.21;; son of: Lamech (H3929) and Adah (H5711);; brother of: Jabal (H2989), Tubal-cain (H8423), Naamah (H5279); § Jubal = "stream"; the son of Lamech by Adah and the inventor of musical instruments
H3106.description: Jubal was the father of all who play the lyre and pipe.

H3107.definition: A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.12.22;; son of: Shimeath (H8100); also called Zabad at 2Ch.24.26;; Another name of yo.za.khar (יוֹזָכָר "Jozacar" H3108); § Jozabad or Josabad = "Jehovah has endowed"; a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David; one of David's mighty warriors; another of David's mighty warriors; four other priests or Levites
H3107.description: One of two men called Jozabad who, along with other Manassite leaders, joined David at Ziklag when he was returning to fight against the Philistines.

H3108.definition: A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.12.22;; son of: Shimeath (H8100); also called Zabad at 2Ch.24.26;; § Jozachar = "Jehovah remembers"; a servant of king Joash of Judah and one of his murderers (also called 'Zabad')

senses.text: A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.12.22;
son of: Shimeath (H8100); also called Zabad at 2Ch.24.26;
a servant of king Joash of Judah and one of his murderers

H3108.description: Jozacar (or Zabad), along with Jehozabad, was one of the servants who conspired against and killed King Joash of Judah.

H3109.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.16;; son of: Beriah (H1283I);; brother of: Arad (H6166B), Ahio (H0283H), Shashak (H8349), Jeremoth (H3406I), Zebadiah (H2069), Eder (H5738), Michael (H4317L) and Ishpah (H3472); § Joha = "Jehovah gives life"; one of the sons of Beriah the Benjamite; the Tizite, one of David's mighty warriors
H3109.description: Joha the Tizite was one of David's mighty warriors, known for his bravery and military skill.

H3110.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.23;; son of: Kareah (H7143);; brother of: Jonathan (H3129L); § Johanan = "Jehovah has graced"; a priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim who returned with Zerubbabel; a Jewish captain after the fall of Jerusalem; the eldest son of king Josiah; a post-exilic prince of the line of David; father of Azariah, priest in Solomon's time; a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors; a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors; a returning exile
H3110.description: Johanan is listed in the genealogy of David as a descendant of King Jehoiachin.

H3111.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.6;; son of: Paseah (H6454I); § Joiada or Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"; son of Paseah, who assisted to repair the old gate of Jerusalem; son of the high priest Eliashib in the time of Nehemiah
H3111.description: Joiada served as a high priest during the Persian period, succeeding his father Eliashib.

H3112.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.24.6;; son of: Jehoiakim (H3079) and Nehushta (H5179);; father of: Zedekiah (H6667I)(?) and Shealtiel (H7597A); also called Jeconiah at 1Ch.3.16,17; 2x27.20; 28.4; 29.2;  Coniah at Jer.22.24,28; 37.1; Shallum at Jer.22.11; Jechoniah (KJV: Jechonias; NIV: Jeconiah) inMat.1.11; 1x; Another spelling of ye.ho.ya.khin (יְהוֹיָכִין "Jehoiachin" H3078); § Jehoiachin = "Jehovah establishes"; king of Judah, son of Jehoiakim, and the next to last king of Judah before the Babylonian captivity; kingship lasted for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar who took him to Babylon and imprisoned him for 36 years when he was finally released

H3113.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.12.10;; son of: Joshua (H3091J);; father of: Eliashib (H0475N); § Joiakim or Jehoiakim = "Jehovah raises up"; a priest and son of Jeshua the high priest
H3113.description: Joiakim served as a high priest during the early Persian period, succeeding his father Jeshua.

H3114.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi  living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.10;; father of: Jedaiah (H3048); also called Jehoiarib at 1Ch.9.10;; Also named: ye.ho.ya.riv (יְהוֹיָרִיב "Jehoiarib" H3080H); § Joiarib = "Jehovah contends"; the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time; a teacher in the time of Ezra; a Judaite in the time of Nehemiah
H3114.description: Joiarib (or Jehoiarib) was a priestly family that returned from the Babylonian exile and settled in Jerusalem.

H3115.definition: A woman of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.20;; daughter of: Levi (H3878);; sister of: Gershon (H1648), Kohath (H6955) and Merari (H4847); married to Amram (H6019);; mother of: Moses (H4872), Aaron (H0175) and Miriam (H4813); § Jochebed = "Jehovah is glory"; the daughter of Levi, wife and at the same time aunt of Amram, and the mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
H3115.description: Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, married her nephew Amram and became the mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

H3116.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Jer.37.3;; son of: Shelemiah (H8018M); also called Jucal (NIV: Jehukal) at Jer.38.1;; Another name of ye.hu.khal (יְהוּכַל "Jehucal" H3081); § Jucal = "Jehovah is able"; a son of Shelemiah and a servant of king Zedekiah whom he sent to Jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice

H3117.definition: : day/when/time/period; day, time, year (day (as opposed to night); day (24 hour period); as defined by evening and morning in Genesis 1; as a division of time (a working day, a day's journey); days, lifetime (pl.); time, period (general); year; temporal references; today; yesterday; tomorrow)

children.text: as defined by evening and morning in Genesis 1
a working day, a day's journey

H3118.definition: day; day always refers to a twenty-four hour period when the word is modified by a definite or cardinal number

H3119.definition: adv; by day, in the daytime; subst; daytime

H3120.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.2;; son of: Japheth (H3315);; brother of: Gomer (H1586), Magog (H4031), Madai (H4074), Tubal (H8422), Meshech (H4902) and Tiras (H8494);; father of: Elishah (H0473), Tarshish (H8659), Kittim (H3794) and Dodanim (H1721); also called Greek at Jol.3.6 + NT.; § Javan = "Ionia" or "Greece"; a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah; Greece, Ionia, Ionians (location of descendants of Javan)

senses.text: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.2;
brother of: Gomer (H1586), Magog (H4031), Madai (H4074), Tubal (H8422), Meshech (H4902) and Tiras (H8494);
father of: Elishah (H0473), Tarshish (H8659), Kittim (H3794) and Dodanim (H1721); also called Greek at Jol.3.6 + NT.
a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah

H3120.description: Javan, the ancestor of the Greek people, was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah.

H3122.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.13.3;; son of: Shimeah (H8093); also called Jonathan at 2Sa.21.21; 1x27.32;; § Jonadab or Jehonadab = "Jehovah is willing"; a son of Rechab, chief of the Rechabites, in the time of Jehu and Ahab; a nephew of David
H3122.description: Jonadab, also known as Jonathan, was the son of David's brother Shimeah and a friend and advisor to Amnon, David's eldest son.

H3124.definition: A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.14.25;; son of: Amittai (H0573); Also named: Iōnas (Ἰωνᾶς "Jonah" G2495H); § Jonah = "dove"; son of Amittai and a native of Gath-hepher; 5th of the minor prophets who prophesied during the reign of Jeroboam II and whom God sent also to prophecy to Nineveh
H3124.description: Jonah, a prophet from Gath-hepher, was sent to preach to Nineveh.

H3125.definition: Someone from Greece, founded by Java who was a man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.2;; son of: Japheth (H3315);; brother of: Gomer (H1586), Magog (H4031), Madai (H4074), Tubal (H8422), Meshech (H4902) and Tiras (H8494);; father of: Elishah (H0473), Tarshish (H8659), Kittim (H3794) and Dodanim (H1721); also called Greek at Jol.3.6 + NT.; Group of ya.van (יָוָן "Javan" H3120); Grecian, Ionian

H3128.definition: § Jonath-elem-recho-kim = "the silent dove of far-off places"; meaning uncertain (probably name of melody; only used in title of Ps 56:1)

senses.text: § Jonath-elem-recho-kim = "the silent dove of far-off places"

children.text: only used in title of Ps 56:1

H3128.description: Jonath-elem-rechokim, meaning "Dove on Far-off Terebinths," is a musical term or phrase found in the superscription of Psalm 56, possibly indicating the melody or musical setting to which the psalm was to be sung.

H3129.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.32;; son of: Jada (H3047);; brother of: Jether (H3500I);; father of: Peleth (H6431H) and Zaza (H2117); § Jonathan or Jehonathan = "Jehovah has given"; a son of king Saul and a friend of David; a son of the high priest Abiathar and the last descendant of Eli of whom we hear; one of David's mighty warriors; a Levite and father of Zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall; a son of Kareah and a brother of Johanan; a Judaite captain after the fall of Jerusalem; another Judaite; father of Ebed in the time of Ezra; son of Asahel in the time of Ezra; a priest of the family of Melicu in the time of Nehemiah; son of Joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of Nehemiah
H3129.description: One of the descendants of Judah, Jonathan was the son of Jada.

H3130.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.30.24;; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354);; brother of: Benjamin (H1144);; half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); married to Asenath (H0621);; father of: Manasseh (H4519) and Ephraim (H0669); also called Zaphenath-paneah at Gen.41.45;; § Joseph = "Jehovah has added"; the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel; father of Igal, who represented the tribe of Issachar among the spies; a son of Asaph; a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; a priest of the family of Shebaniah in the time of Nehemiah
H3130.description: Joseph, a son of Asaph, was a musician who served during King David's reign.

H3131.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.8.10;; father of: Shelomith (H8019H); § Josiphiah = "Jehovah adds"; father or ancestor of Shelomith who returned with Ezra
H3131.description: Josiphiah was the father of Shelomith, who was among the exiles who returned with Ezra to Jerusalem.

H3132.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.7;; son of: Jeroham (H3395K);; brother of: Zebadiah (H2069I); § Joelah = "may he avail"; son of Jeroham of Gedor and one of David's mighty warriors
H3132.description: Joelah, a Benjaminite warrior, was among those who joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

H3133.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.11.7;; son of: Pedaiah (H6305L);; father of: Meshullam (H4918W); § Joed = "Jehovah is witness"; a Benjamite, son of Pedaiah
H3133.description: Joed, a Benjaminite, was among those who resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H3134.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.6; § Joezer = "Jehovah is help"; a Korhite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag
H3134.description: Joezer, a Korahite warrior, was among the Benjaminites who joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

H3135.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.8;; son of: Becher (H1071);; brother of: Zemirah (H2160), Eliezer (H0461I), Elioenai (H0454I), Omri (H6018H), Jeremoth (H3406H), Abijah (H0029K), Anathoth (H6068H) and Alemeth (H5964H); § Joash = "Jehovah hastens"; a Benjamite, son of Becher; one of the officers in David's court
H3135.description: Joash the Abiezrite was responsible for King David's olive and sycamore trees in the Shephelah.

H3136.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.14;; son of: Seraiah (H8304H);; brother of: Ezra (H5830);; father of: Joshua (H3091J); also called Jozadak at Ezr.3.2,8; 5.2; 1x; Another name of ye.ho.tsa.daq (יְהוֹצָדָק "Jehozadak" H3087); § Jozadak = "Jehovah is righteous"; grandson of the high priest Hilkiah; son of the high priest Seraiah; and father of the high priest Joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar
H3136.description: Among the descendants of Jozadak, some priests were found to have married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H3137.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.22;; son of: Shelah (H7956);; brother of: Er (H6147H), Laadah (H3935), Joash (H3101K) and Saraph (H8315); § Jokim = "Jehovah raises up"; a descendant of Judah
H3137.description: Jokim was a descendant of Judah through Shelah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H3138.definition: early rain, autumn shower (rain which falls in Palestine from late October until early December)

children.text: rain which falls in Palestine from late October until early December

H3139.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.18; also called Hariph at Neh.7.24;; Also named: cha.riph (חָרִיף "Hariph" H2756H); § Jorah = "he instructs"; the head or ancestor of a family who returned from Babylon with Ezra
H3139.description: The descendants of Jorah (or Hariph) were among the exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

H3140.definition: A man of the tribe of Gad  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.13;; son of: Abihail (H0032I);; brother of: Michael (H4317H), Meshullam (H4918I), Sheba (H7652), Jacan (H3275), Zia (H2127) and Eber (H5677H); § Jorai = "Jehovah has taught me"; one of the Gadites dwelling at Gilead in Bashan in the reign of king Jotham of Judah
H3140.description: Jorai was a clan chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the reign of King Jotham of Judah.

H3141.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.10;; son of: Toi (H8583); also called Hadoram at 1Ch.18.10;; Also named: ha.do.ram (הֲדוֹרָם "Hadoram" H1913); § Joram = "Jehovah is exalted"; son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and himself king of Judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked Athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of Judah to the worship of Baal; son of king Ahab of the northern kingdom of Israel and king of Israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by Jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered Naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of Elijah to the very letter; a Levite in the time of David and an ancestor of Shelomith; son of Toi, king of Hamath
H3141.description: Joram was a Levite who served during the reign of King David.

H3142.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.3.20;; son of: Zerubbabel (H2216);; brother of: Meshullam (H4918H), Hananiah (H2608L), Shelomith (H8019I), Hashubah (H2807), Ohel (H0169), Berechiah (H1296), Hasadiah (H2619) and Abiud (G0010); § Jushab-hesed = "whose love is returned"; son of Zerubbabel
H3142.description: Jushab-hesed was one of the sons of Zerubbabel, a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah.

H3143.definition: A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.35;; son of: Seraiah (H8304K);; father of: Jehu (H3058J); § Josibiah = "Jehovah causes to dwell"; a Simeonite, father of Jehu
H3143.description: Joshibiah was one of the leaders from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H3144.definition: A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.34;; son of: Amaziah (H0558H); § Joshah = "Jehovah makes equal"; a prince of the house of Simeon
H3144.description: Joshah was one of the leaders from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H3145.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.46;; son of: Elnaam (H0493);; brother of: Jeribai (H3403); § Joshaviah = "Jehovah makes equal"; son of Elnaam and one of David's mighty warriors
H3145.description: Joshaviah, a son of Elnaam, was listed among David's mighty warriors.

H3146.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.43; § Joshaphat or Jehoshaphat = "Jehovah judges"; one of David's mighty warriors; a priest and trumpeter in the time of David
H3146.description: Joshaphat the Mithnite was listed among David's mighty warriors.

H3147.definition: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.9.5;; son of: Gideon (H1439);; brother of: Jether (H3500) and Abimelech (H0040H); § Jotham = "Jehovah is perfect"; son of king Uzziah of Judah by Jerushah; king of Judah for 16 years and contemporary with Isaiah and king Pekah of Israel; son of Jahdai and a descendant of Caleb and Judah; youngest son of Gideon who escaped from the massacre of his brothers
H3147.description: Jotham was a son of Jahdai, who was a wife of Caleb.

H3148.definition: superiority, advantage, excess; adv; excess, better; conj; besides, moreover, more

H3149.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.3;; son of: Azmaveth (H5820I);; brother of: Pelet (H6404H); § Jeziel = "the assembly of God"; a Benjamite and one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag
H3149.description: Jeziel, a Benjamite, was one of the warriors who joined David at Ziklag.

H3150.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.25; § Jeziah = "Jehovah sprinkles"; a descendant of Parosh who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
H3150.description: Izziah, a descendant of Parosh, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

H3151.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.31; § Jaziz = "He makes prominent"; a Hagarite, officer of David in charge of the flocks
H3151.description: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of King David's flocks.

H3152.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.18;; son of: Elpaal (H0508);; brother of: Eber (H5677I), Misham (H4936), Shemed (H8106B), Beriah (H1283I), Shema (H8087I), Zebadiah (H2069H), Meshullam (H4918J), Hizki (H2395), Heber (H2268J), Ishmerai (H3461) and Jobab (H3103K); § Jezliah = "whom God will preserve"; a Benjamite of the sons of Elpaal
H3152.description: Izliah was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Elpaal.

H3153.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.23;; son of: Hoshaiah (H1955H); also called Jaazaniah at 2Ki.25.23;  Azariah at Jer.43.2;; § Jezaniah = "Jehovah has listened"; son of Hoshaiah the Maachathite and one of the captains who escaped from Jerusalem during the last siege of the Babylonians; one of the first to return to Gedaliah at Mizpah where he took a prominent part after the assassination of Gedaliah
H3153.description: Jezaniah, also known as Azariah, was a leader of the Judean forces after the fall of Jerusalem.

H3155.definition: Someone descended from Zerah who was a man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.38.30;; son of: Judah (H3063) and Tamar (H8559);; brother of: Perez (H6557);; half-brother of: Er (H6147), Onan (H0209) and Shelah (H7956);; father of: Zabdi (H2067), Ethan (H0387H), Heman (H1968H), Calcol (H3633H) and Dara (H1873); also called Izrahite at 1Ch.27.8;; Group of ze.rach (זֶ֫רַח "Zerah" H2226I); § Izrahite = "descendant of Zerah"; a descendant of Zerah of Judah

H3156.definition: A man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.7.3;; son of: Uzzi (H5813H);; father of: Michael (H4317K), Obadiah (H5662I), Joel (H3100L) and Isshiah (H3449); § Izrahiah or Jezrahiah = "Jehovah will shine"; a chieftain of Issachar; a Levite and leader of the chorus at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah
H3156.description: Izrahiah, a son of Uzzi, was a descendant of Issachar and a clan head.

H3157.definition: Jezreel = "God sows"; a city in the Nekeb of Judah; Also named: yiz.re.e.li (יִזְרְעֵאלִי "Jezreel" H3158)
H3157.description: Jezreel was a son of Hur, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H3158.definition: Jezreelite , of Jezreel "sown of God"; an inhabitant of Jezreel; Another spelling of yiz.re.el (יִזְרְעֶאל "Jezreel" H3157)

H3159.definition: Jezreelitess , of Jezreel "sown of God"; a female inhabitant of Jezreel (used only of Ahinoam, a wife of David)

children.text: used only of Ahinoam, a wife of David

H3160.definition: A man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.34;; son of: Shomer (H7763H);; brother of: Ahi (H0277H), Rohgah (H7303) and Aram (H0758J); § Jehubbah = "hidden"; a man of Asher, son of Shomer or Shamer of the house of Beriah
H3160.description: Jehubbah was a descendant of Asher mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

H3161.definition: to join, unite, be joined, be united ((Qal) to be united; (Piel) to unite)

senses.text: to join, unite, be joined, be united

H3163.definition: A man of the tribe of Gad  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.14;; son of: Buz (H0938H);; father of: Jeshishai (H3454); § Jahdo = "His unity"; a Gileadite, son of Buz and father of Jeshishai
H3163.description: Jahdo, a son of Buz, was a descendant of Gad and a clan head.

H3164.definition: A man of the tribe of Manasseh  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.24; § Jahdiel = "my unity is God"; a chief of Manasseh on the east of the Jordan
H3164.description: Jahdiel was a mighty warrior and head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh, east of the Jordan.

H3165.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.20;; son of: Shebuel (H7619); § Jehdeiah = "Jehovah is unity"; a Levite in the time of David; a Meronothite, officer of David in charge of the she-asses
H3165.description: Jehdeiah was a Levite descendant of Amram who served during the reign of King David.

H3166.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.4; § Jahaziel = "beheld of God"; a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag; a priest in the reign of David who helped move the ark; a Kohathite Levite, 3rd son of Hebron; a Levite, son of Zechariah, of the sons of Asaph, in the reign of Jehoshaphat; an ancestor of one of the families who returned from exile with Ezra
H3166.description: Jahaziel, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the mighty men who joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

H3167.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.15;; son of: Tikvah (H8616H); § Jahaziah = "Jehovah views"; son of Tikvah, apparently a priest and leader during the time of Ezra
H3167.description: Jahzeiah, along with three others, opposed Ezra's order for Israelites to divorce their foreign wives.

H3168.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.16; § Ezekiel or Jehezekel = "God strengthens"; son of Buzi and a priest and prophet; author of the book by his name; taken captive with Jehoiachin and exiled in Babylon where he prophesied for the next 22 years; a priest in charge of the 20th course in the time of David
H3168.description: Ezekiel's wife died suddenly, and God used her death as a sign to the people of Israel.

H3169.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.28.12;; son of: Shallum (H7967N); § Hezekiah or Jehizkiah = "Jehovah has made strong"; son of king Ahazby Abi or Abijah and the 12th king of Judah; his reign was characterised by his godly conduct; reigned for 29 years; head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah; an Ephraimite in the time of Ahaz
H3169.description: Jehizkiah, an Ephraimite leader, opposed taking Judean captives during the reign of King Ahaz of Judah.

H3170.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi  living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.12;; son of: Meshullam (H4918M);; father of: Adiel (H5717H); § Jahzerah = "whom God leads back"; a priest of the house of Immer
H3170.description: Jahzerah was a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

H3171.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; § Jehiel = "God lives"; a Levite and one of the chief musicians in the time of David; a Gershonite Levite who had charge of the treasures in the time of David; son of Hachmoni and an officer of David and tutor of David's sons; a son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah put to death by his brother Jehoram; Hemanite who took part in the restoration of king Hezekiah; a Levite and overseer in the time of Hezekiah; a ruler of the temple during the reforms of Josiah; father of Obadiah of the sons of Joab in the time of Ezra; father of Shechaniah of the sons of Elam in the time of Ezra; a son of Elam who put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra; a priest of the sons of Harim who also had to put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra
H3171.description: Jehiel was a Levitical musician who played the harp and lyre during the reign of King David.

H3172.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.23.8;; son of Libni (H3845G) ;; brother of: Zetham (H2241) and Joel (H3100O);;; Another name of ye.chi.el (יְחִיאֵל "Jehiel" H3171H); § Jehieli = "God shall save alive" or "swept away of God"; a Gershonite Levite of the family of Laadan

children.text: (Hiphil) to wait, tarry, wait for, hope for

H3177.definition: A man of the tribe of Zebulun living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.14;; son of: Zebulun (H2074);; brother of: Sered (H5624) and Elon (H0356H); Also named: yach.le.e.li (יַחְלְאֵלִי "Jahleelite" H3178); § Jahleel = "God waits"; the 3rd of the 3 sons of Zebulun; founder of the family of the Jahleelites
H3177.description: Jahleel, son of Zebulun, was a grandson of Jacob and a clan leader.

H3178.definition: Someone descended from Jahleel who was a man of the tribe of Zebulun living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.14;; son of: Zebulun (H2074);; brother of: Sered (H5624) and Elon (H0356H); Group of yach.le.el (יַחְלְאֵל "Jahleel" H3177); § Jahleelites = "the hope of God"; descendants of Jahleel of the tribe of Zebulun

H3180.definition: roebuck (a kind of deer, reddish in colour; perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown)

H3181.definition: A man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.2;; son of: Tola (H8439);; brother of: Uzzi (H5813H), Rephaiah (H7509I), Jeriel (H3400), Ibsam (H3005) and Shemuel (H8050I); § Jahmai = "whom Jehovah guards"; a man of Issachar and one of the heads of the family of Tola
H3181.description: Jahmai, a son of Tola, was a descendant of Issachar and a clan head.

H3183.definition: A man of the tribe of Naphtali living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.24;; son of: Naphtali (H5321);; brother of: Guni (H1476), Jezer (H3337) and Shillem (H8006); also called Jahziel at 1Ch.7.13;; § Jahzeel = "God divides"; the 1st of the 4 sons of Naphtali and founder of the family of Jahzeelites
H3183.description: Jahzeel (or Jahziel), son of Naphtali, was a grandson of Jacob and a clan leader.

H3184.definition: Someone descended from Jahzeel who was a man of the tribe of Naphtali living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.24;; son of: Naphtali (H5321);; brother of: Guni (H1476), Jezer (H3337) and Shillem (H8006); also called Jahziel at 1Ch.7.13;; Group of yach.tse.el (יַחְצְאֵל "Jahzeel" H3183); § Jahzeelites , of Jahzeel "God divides"; the descendants of Jahzeel, the 1st son of Naphtali

H3185.definition: A man of the tribe of Naphtali living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.24;; son of: Naphtali (H5321);; brother of: Guni (H1476), Jezer (H3337) and Shillem (H8006); also called Jahziel at 1Ch.7.13;; Another name of yach.tse.el (יַחְצְאֵל "Jahzeel" H3183); § Jahziel = "God divides"; the 1st of the 4 sons of Naphtali and founder of the family of Jahzeelites

H3189.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.4.2;; son of: Haroeh (H7204);; father of: Ahumai (H0267) and Lahad (H3855); § Jahath = "He will snatch up"; son of Reaiah and grandson of Shobal of the tribe of Judah; a son of Libni and grandson of Gershom and great grandson of Levi; a Gershonite Levite; the eldest son of Shimei and the grandson of Laadan; founder of the house of Jahath; a Levite and son of Shelomoth; a Merarite Levite in the reign of Josiah
H3189.description: Jahath was a Levite, a descendant of Shimei, and a grandson of Gershon.

H3192.description: Jotbah, the hometown of Meshullemeth; mother of King Amon of Judah (2Ki.21.19).

H3193.definition: § Jotbath or Jotbathah = "pleasantness"; a stopping place in the wilderness
H3193.description: Jotbathah, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey, known for its streams of water (Numbers 33:33-34; Deu.10.7).

H3194.definition: § Juttah = "stretched out"; a town in the mountains of Judah, in the neighbourhood of Maon and Carmel; modern 'Yutta'
H3194.description: Juttah, a town in the hill country of Judah, was designated as a Levitical city (Joshua 15:55; 21:16).

H3199.description: Jachin was the head of the twenty-first priestly division organized by King David.

H3200.definition: Someone descended from Jachin who was a man of the tribe of Simeon living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.10;; son of: Simeon (H8095);; brother of: Jemuel (H3223), Jamin (H3226), Ohad (H0161), Zerah (H2226L)  and Shaul (H7586H); also called Jarib at 1Ch.4.24;; Group of ya.khin (יָכִין "Jachin" H3199); § Jachinites , of Jachin "he will establish"; the descendants of Jachin

H3203.description: Jecoliah was the mother of King Uzziah (also known as Azariah) of Judah.

H3204.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.24.6;; son of: Jehoiakim (H3079) and Nehushta (H5179);; father of: Zedekiah (H6667I)(?) and Shealtiel (H7597A); also called Jeconiah at 1Ch.3.16,17; 2x27.20; 28.4; 29.2;  Coniah at Jer.22.24,28; 37.1; Shallum at Jer.22.11; Jechoniah (KJV: Jechonias; NIV: Jeconiah) inMat.1.11; 1x; Another name of ye.ho.ya.khin (יְהוֹיָכִין "Jehoiachin" H3078); § Jeconiah = "Jehovah will establish"; son of king Jehoiakim of Judah and king of Judah for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar and was taken captive to Babylon where he was imprisoned for the next 36 years; released at the death of Nebuchadnezzar and lived in Babylon until his death (primary spelling 'Jehoiachin')

H3397.definition: Someone descended from Jerahmeel who was a man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.27.10;; son of: Hezron (H2696H);; brother of: Ram (H7410), Caleb (H3612H), Segub (H7687H) and Ashhur (H0806); married to Atarah (H5851);; father of: Ram (H7410H), Bunah (H0946), Oren (H0767), Ozem (H0684H), Ahijah (H0281J) and Onam (H0208H); Group of ye.rach.me.el (יְרַחְמְאֵל "Jerahmeel" H3396); § Jerahmeelites , of Jerahmeel "may God have pity"; the descendants of Jerahmeel, the great grandson of Judah

H3398.definition: A man of Egypt living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.34; married to Ahlai (H0304);; father of: Attai (H6262); § Jarha = "the month of sweeping away"; the Egyptian slave of Sheshan, about the time of Eli, to whom his master gave his daughter or heir as wife
H3398.description: Jarha was an Egyptian servant who married the daughter of Sheshan, a descendant of Judah.

H3399.definition: to precipitate, be precipitate, push headlong, drive recklessly

H3400.definition: A man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.2;; son of: Tola (H8439);; brother of: Uzzi (H5813H), Rephaiah (H7509I), Jahmai (H3181), Ibsam (H3005) and Shemuel (H8050I); § Jeriel = "taught by God"; one of the 6 heads of the house of Tola of the tribe of Issachar
H3400.description: Jeriel was one of the sons of Tola and a leader in the tribe of Issachar, as mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3402.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.8.16; § Jarib = "he contends"; a son of Simeon; one of the chief men of Israel who returned from exile with Ezra; son of Jozadak and a priest of the house of Jeshua who married a foreign wife and was compelled by Ezra to put her away
H3402.description: Jarib was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

H3403.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.46;; son of: Elnaam (H0493);; brother of: Joshaviah (H3145); § Jeribai = "my contentions"; a descendant of Elnaam and one of David's mighty warriors
H3403.description: Jeribai was listed among David's mighty men, a group of skilled warriors who fought alongside him.

H3404.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.23.19;; son of: Hebron (H2275B);; brother of: Amariah (H0568I), Jahaziel (H3166I) and Jekameam (H3360); § Jerijah or Jeriah = " taught by Jehovah"; a Kohathite Levite and chief of the house of Hebron when David organised the service
H3404.description: Jeriah was a Levite, the firstborn son of Hebron, and an ancestor of the Hebronites who served in the tabernacle during David's reign.

H3405.definition: Jericho = "its moon"; a city 5 miles (8 km) west of the Jordan and 7 miles (11.5 km) north of the Dead Sea and the first city conquered by the Israelites upon entering the promised land of Canaan; Also named: Hierichō (Ἱεριχώ "Jericho" G2410)
H3405.description: Jericho, an ancient Canaanite city famously conquered by the Israelites under Joshua's leadership.

H3406.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.7;; son of: Bela (H1106A);; brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265); § Jerimoth or Jeremoth = "He is Most High"; a Benjamite, son of Bela and head of a house of Benjamite; a Benjamite, son of Becher and head of a house of Benjamite; a Benjamite, son of Beriah and grandson of Elpaal; a Merarite Levite, son of Mushi; one of the men that joined David in the wilderness; a Levite, son of Heman and head of the 15th course of musicians; a Levite in the reign of Hezekiah; a son of Azriel, ruler of the tribe of Naphtali in the reign of David; a son of king David and the father of the wife of Rehoboam; a son of Elam, a man with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; a son of Zattu, a man with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
H3406.description: Jeremoth was a son of Becher and a member of the tribe of Benjamin, as mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3408.definition: A womanof the tribe of Judah  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.18; married to Caleb (H3612H); § Jerioth = "curtains"; the wife or concubine of Caleb, the son of Hezron of the descendants of Judah
H3408.description: Jerioth was one of the wives of Caleb, and she bore him some unnamed children, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

H3412.definition: § Jarmuth = "heights"; a Canaanitish city in the lowlands of Judah with a king and located between Hebron and Lachish
H3412.description: Jarmuth, a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua, later allotted to Judah.

H3413.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.33; § Jeremai = "my exaltations"; a descendant of Hashum who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra and was compelled to put her away
H3413.description: Jeremai, a descendant of Hashum, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

H3414.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.23.31;; father of: Hamutal (H2537); § Jeremiah = "whom Jehovah has appointed"; the major prophet, son of Hilkiah of the priestly family in Anathoth; author of the prophetic book bearing his name; a man of Libnah and father of Hamutal the wife of king Josiah; a Gadite who joined David at Ziklag; a Manassehite, one of the mighty men of valour of the Transjordanic half tribe of Manasseh; a Gadite and warrior of David; a warrior of David; a priest who joined Nehemiah in the covenant ceremony; a priest also in the time of Nehemiah; maybe same as 7; father of Jaazaniah the Rechabites
H3414.description: Jeremiah was one of the Gadite warriors who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

H3416.definition: § Irpeel = "God will heal"; a city in Benjamin
H3416.description: Irpeel, a town in the territory of Benjamin (Joshua 18:27).

H3421.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.44;; son of: Raham (H7357); § Jorkoam = "the people empty"; a Calebite descendant of Judah
H3421.description: Jorkeam was a descendant of Caleb or a town founded by Raham in the tribe of Judah.

senses.text: being, existence, substance, there is or are
