H3428.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.13; § Jeshebeab = "dwelling of the father"; a Levite, head of the 14th course of the priests
H3428.description: Jeshebeab was the head of the fourteenth division of priests during the time of David.

H3429.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.8;; son of: Zabdiel (H2068); also called Josheb-basshebeth (KJV: "that sat in the seat") at 2Sa.23.8;; Another name of ya.shov.am (יָשׇׁבְעָם "Jashobeam" H3434G); § Josheb-basshebeth = "dwelling in rest"; one of David's mighty warriors

H3430.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.21.16;; son of: Rapha (H7497A);; brother of: Goliath (H1555), Saph (H5593), Lahmi (H3902) and huge_man (H4060A); § Ishbi-benob = "his dwelling is in Nob"; son of Rapha, one of the nation of Philistine giants who attacked David in battle and was slain by Abishai
H3430.description: Ishbi-benob, a Philistine giant, was killed by David's warrior Abishai when he threatened David's life.

H3431.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.17;; son of: Mered (H4778) and Bithiah (H1332);; brother of: Miriam (H4813H) and Shammai (H8060I);; half-brother of: Jered (H3382H)(?), Heber (H2268I)(?) and Jekuthiel (H3354)(?); married to Hodiah (H1940)(?);; father of: son_of_Hodiah (H3431H)(?); § Ishbah = "he will praise"; father of Eshtemoa and descendant of Judah
H3431.description: Ishbah's sons were the  father (ie founder) of Eshtemoa and Keilah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah..

H3432.definition: Someone descended from Jashub who was a man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.13;; son of: Issachar (H3485);; brother of: Tola (H8439), Puah (H6312) and Shimron (H8110B); also called Yob (KJV: Job) at Gen.46.13;; Group of ya.shuv (יָשׁוּב "Jashub" H3437H); § Jashubites , of Jashub "he will return"; descendants of Jashub of the tribe of Issachar

H3433.definition: Jashubi-lehem = "returner of bread"; a descendant of Shelah, the son of Judah by Bath-shua the Canaanitess; Another name of bet le.chem (בֵּית לֶ֫חֶם "Bethlehem" H1035G)

H3434.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.8;; son of: Zabdiel (H2068); also called Josheb-basshebeth (KJV: "that sat in the seat") at 2Sa.23.8;; Also named: yo.shev bash.she.vet (יֹשֵׁב בַּשֶּׁ֫בֶת "Josheb-basshebeth" H3429); § Jashobeam = "the people will return"; a Hachmonite, the leader of the 30 mighty warriors of David; he joined David at Ziklag and was best known as the man who slew 800 or 300 men at one time; also called 'Adino the Eznite'; a Korahite, another of David's mighty warriors; same as 1?
H3434.description: Jashobeam was a Korahite who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

H3435.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.2;; son of: Abraham (H0085) and Keturah (H6989);; brother of: Zimran (H2175), Jokshan (H3370), Medan (H4091), Midian (H4080) and Shuah (H7744);; half-brother of: Ishmael (H3458) and Isaac (H3327); § Ishbak = "he releases"; a son of Abraham by Keturah and progenitor of an Arabian tribe
H3435.description: Ishbak was a son of Abraham and his concubine Keturah.

H3436.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.25.4;; son of: Heman (H1968I);; brother of: Bukkiah (H1232), Mattaniah (H4983H), Uzziel (H5816J), Shebuel (H7619H), Jerimoth (H3406L), Hananiah (H2608P), Hanani (H2607H), Eliathah (H0448), Giddalti (H1437), Romamti-ezer (H7320), Mallothi (H4413), Hothir (H1956), Mahazioth (H4238); § Joshbekashah = "seated in hardness"; son of Heman and the leader of the 17th course of musicians
H3436.description: Joshbekashah, one of Heman's sons, was a musician appointed by King David to lead worship.

H3437.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.29; § Jashub = "he will return"; the 3rd son of Issachar and founder of the family of Jashubites; one of the sons of Bani who had to put away a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
H3437.description: Jashub was an Israelite who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

H3438.definition: A man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.17;; son of: Asher (H0836);; brother of: Imnah (H3232), Ishvi (H3440), Beriah (H1283) and Serah (H8294); § Ishuai or Isuah = "he will resemble"; the 2nd son of Asher
H3438.description: Ishvah was a son of Asher and grandson of Jacob.

H3439.definition: A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.36; § Jeshohaiah = "Jehovah humbles"; a descendant of Shimei and a chief of the Simeonites
H3439.description: Jeshohaiah was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during the time of King Hezekiah.

H3440.definition: A man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.17;; son of: Asher (H0836);; brother of: Imnah (H3232), Ishvah (H3438), Beriah (H1283) and Serah (H8294); Also named: yish.vi (יִשְׁוִי "Ishvite" H3441); § Ishui or Ishuai or Isui or Jesui = "he resembles me"; the 2nd son of Saul by his wife Ahinoam; the 3rd son of Asher and founder of the family of Ishuaites
H3440.description: Ishvi (or Isui) was a son of Asher and grandson of Jacob.

H3441.definition: Someone descended from Ishvi who was a man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.17;; son of: Asher (H0836);; brother of: Imnah (H3232), Ishvah (H3438), Beriah (H1283) and Serah (H8294); Group of yish.vi (יִשְׁוִי "Ishvi" H3440); § Jesuites , of Jesui "he will justify me"; the descendants of Jesui ( yish.vi (יִשְׁוִי "Ishvi" H3440)

H3442.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.24.11;; son of: Jozadak (H3136); § Jeshua = "he is saved"; son of Nun of the tribe of Ephraim and successor to Moses as the leader of the children of Israel; led the conquest of Canaan; son of Jehozadak and high priest after the restoration; a priest in the time of David who had charge of the 9th course; a Levite in the reign of Hezekiah; head of a Levitical house which returned from captivity in Babylon; father of a builder of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; a town in southern Judah reinhabited by the people of Judah after the return from captivity
H3442.description: Jeshua was the head of a priestly family that returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

H3443.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2;; son of: Jehozadak (H3087);; father of: Joiakim (H3113); also called Jeshua at Ezr.2.2; 3.2,8; 4.3; 5.2; 1x12.1,7,10,26;; Aramaic of ye.ho.shu.a (יְהוֹשׁוּעַ "Joshua" H3091J); § Jeshua = "he is saved"; an exilic priest who returned with Zerubbabel

H3444.definition: salvation, deliverance (welfare, prosperity; deliverance; salvation (by God); victory)

H3446.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.17.19;; son of: Abraham (H0085) and Sarah (H8283);; half-brother of: Ishmael (H3458), Zimran (H2175), Jokshan (H3370), Medan (H4091), Midian (H4080), Ishbak (H3435) and Shuah (H7744); married to Rebekah (H7259);; father of: Esau (H6215) and Israel (H3478); Another spelling of yits.chaq (יִצְחָק "Isaac" H3327); § Isaac = "he laughs"; son of Abraham by Sarah his wife and father of Jacob and Esau

H3448.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at Rut.4.17;; son of: Obed (H5744);; father of: David (H1732), Eliab (H0446I), Abinadab (H0041I), Shimeah (H8093), Nethanel (H5417H), Raddai (H7288), Ozem (H0684), Zeruiah (H6870), Abigail (H0026H)(?) and Elihu (H0453J); Also named: Iessai (Ἰεσσαί "Jesse" G2421); § Jesse = "I possess"; son of Boaz and the father of king David
H3448.description: Jesse was the father of King David and an ancestor of Jesus Christ.

H3449.definition: A man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.3;; son of: Izrahiah (H3156);; brother of: Michael (H4317K), Obadiah (H5662I) and Joel (H3100L); § Ishiah or Ishijah or Jesiah = "Jehovah will lend"; a Korhite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag; the 5th of 5 sons of Izrahiah and one of the heads of the tribe of Issachar in the time of David; a Levite, the 2nd son of Uzziel and grandson of Kohath; another Levite, son of Rehabiah; a descendant of Harim who had a foreign wife
H3449.description: Isshiah the Korahite was one of the warriors who joined David at Ziklag.

H3450.definition: A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.36; § Jesimiel = "God will place"; a Simeonite chief of the family of Shimei
H3450.description: Jesimiel was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H3452.description: Jeshimon, a wilderness near Ziph where David hid from Saul (1Sa.23.19, 24; 26:1, 3).

H3454.definition: A man of the tribe of Gad  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.14;; son of: Jahdo (H3163);; father of: Michael (H4317I); § Jeshishai = "my old one"; a Gadite from Gilead
H3454.description: Jeshishai was an ancestor of the Gadite leaders who lived in Bashan, as mentioned in the genealogy of Gad in 1 Chronicles.

H3455.definition: to put, place, set, appoint, make ((Qal) to put, place)

senses.text: to put, place, set, appoint, make

H3457.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.3;; son of: Hur (H2354);; brother of: Uri (H0221), Shobal (H7732H), Salma (H8007H), Hareph (H2780), Jezreel (H3157J), Idbash (H3031), Hazzelelponi (H6753), Penuel (H6439H) and Ezer (H5829); § Ishma = "desolation"; a Judaite descended from Hur
H3457.description: Ishma was a son of Hur, a descendant of Judah.

H3458.definition: A man of Arabia living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.16.11;; son of: Abraham (H0085) and Hagar (H1904);; half-brother of: Isaac (H3327), Zimran (H2175), Jokshan (H3370), Medan (H4091), Midian (H4080), Ishbak (H3435) and Shuah (H7744);; father of: Nebaioth (H5032), Kedar (H6938), Adbeel (H0110), Mibsam (H4017), Mishma (H4927), Dumah (H1746), Massa (H4854), Hadad (H2301), Tema (H8485), Jetur (H3195), Naphish (H5305), Kedemah (H6929) and Mahalath (H4258); § Ishmael = "God will hear"; son of Abraham and Sarah's handmaid Hagar and the progenitor of the Arabian peoples; son of Nethaniah and the murderer of Gedaliah; a Benjamite, one of the sons of Azel a descendant of Saul through Meribbaal or Mephibosheth; a Judaite, father of Zebadiah; a Judaite, son of Johanan and one of the captains who aided Jehoiada in restoring Joash to the throne; a priest of the family of Pashur with a foreign wife whom he was forced to put away by Ezra
H3458.description: Ishmael was a descendant of Benjamin through King Saul's line.

H3459.definition: Someone descended from Ishmael who was a man of Arabia living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.16.11;; son of: Abraham (H0085) and Hagar (H1904);; half-brother of: Isaac (H3327), Zimran (H2175), Jokshan (H3370), Medan (H4091), Midian (H4080), Ishbak (H3435) and Shuah (H7744);; father of: Nebaioth (H5032), Kedar (H6938), Adbeel (H0110), Mibsam (H4017), Mishma (H4927), Dumah (H1746), Massa (H4854), Hadad (H2301), Tema (H8485), Jetur (H3195), Naphish (H5305), Kedemah (H6929) and Mahalath (H4258); Group of yish.ma.el (יִשְׁמָעֵאל "Ishmael" H3458); § Ishmaelite , of Ishmael "God will hear"; a descendant of Ishmael

H3460.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.4; § Ishmaiah = "Jehovah will hear"; a Gibeonite and one of David's mighty warriors; a son of Obadiah and the ruler of the tribe of Zebulun in the time of king David
H3460.description: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite was a mighty warrior among the Thirty who joined David at Ziklag.

H3461.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.18;; son of: Elpaal (H0508);; brother of: Eber (H5677I), Misham (H4936), Shemed (H8106B), Beriah (H1283I), Shema (H8087I), Zebadiah (H2069H), Meshullam (H4918J), Hizki (H2395), Heber (H2268J), Izliah (H3152) and Jobab (H3103K); § Ishmerai = "He keeps me"; a Benjamite of the family of Elpaal
H3461.description: Ishmerai was a descendant of Benjamin through Elpaal.

H3462.definition: to sleep, be asleep ((Qal) to sleep, go to sleep, be asleep; (Niphal); to remain a long time, be stored up; to be festering (of leprosy); (Piel) to cause to sleep, entice to sleep)

H3464.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.32;; also called Hashem at 1Ch.11.34;; Also named: ha.shem (הָשֵׁם "Hashem" H2044); § Jashen = "sleeping"; the father of one or more of David's mighty warriors
H3464.description: Jashen, also known as Hashem, was the father of some of David's mighty men.

H3465.definition: old, store, storage; Also named: ye.sha.nah (יְשָׁנָה "(Gate of )Yeshanah" H3466H)
H3465.description: The Yeshanah Gate, also known as the Old Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall rebuilt by Nehemiah (Neh. 3:6; 12:39).

H3466.definition: § Jeshanah = "storage"; a town of the southern border of the northern kingdom near Bethel
H3466.description: Jeshanah, a town captured by King Abijah of Judah from Jeroboam of Israel (2Ch.13.19).

H5778.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.40.8; § Ephai = "gloomy"; a Netophathite, whose sons were among the captains of the forces left in Judah after the deportation to Babylon
H5778.description: Ephai the Netophathite was the father of one of the men who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.

H5780.definition: A man of the Syrians living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.23;; son of: Aram (H0758);; brother of: Hul (H2343), Gether (H1666) and Mash (H4851); § Uz = "wooded"; son of Aram and grandson of Seth; son of Nahor by Milcah; an Edomite, son of Dishan and grandson of Seir; the country of Job; probably east and southeast of Palestine somewhere in the Arabian desert
H5780.description: Uz, son of Aram and grandson of Shem, was an early Semitic patriarch.

H5793.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah  living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.4;; son of: Ammihud (H5989K); § Uthai = "helpful"; son of Ammihud and a descendant of Pharez of Judah; one of the sons of Bigvai who returned from exile with the 2nd caravan with Ezra
H5793.description: Uthai, a descendant of Perez, resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H5797.definition: might, strength (material or physical; personal or social or political)

H5798.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.6.3;; son of: Abinadab (H0041);; brother of: Eleazar (H0499H) and Ahio (H0283); also called Perez-uzzah at 2Sa.6.8;; Also named: pe.rets uz.za (פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּא "Perez-uzzah" H6560H); § Uzza or Uzzah = "strength"; a man slain by Jehovah for touching the sacred ark; a Benjamite of the sons of Ehud; ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; the garden where kings Manasseh and Amon of Judah were buried
H5798.description: Uzza was a Benjamite born in Moab during the exile.

H5799.definition: entire removal, scapegoat (refers to the goat used for sacrifice for the sins of the people; meaning uncertain); Azazel

children.text: refers to the goat used for sacrifice for the sins of the people

H5802.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.16;; father of: Nehemiah (H5166I); § Azbuk = "strong devastation"; father of Nehemiah, leader of half the district of Beth Zur, and a repairer of the walls of Jerusalem under another Nehemiah
H5802.description: Azbuk was the father of Nehemiah, who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David (Neh.3.16).

H5803.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.12; § Azgad = "Gad is mighty"; ancestor of a family of laymen who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; a man who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
H5803.description: Azgad was the ancestor of 1,222 (or 2,322) exiles who returned to Jerusalem (Ezr.2.12; 8:12; Neh.7.17).

H5804.definition: § Azzah = "the strong"; another name for 'Gaza', a city of the Philistines located in the extreme southwest of Palestine close to the Mediterranean
H5804.description: Gaza, one of the five major Philistine cities, was the site of Samson's exploits and a place visited by Philip the evangelist in the early church.

H5806.definition: A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.42;; daughter of: Shilhi (H7977); married to Asa (H0609);; mother of: Jehoshaphat (H3092I); § Azubah = "forsaken"; wife of Caleb, the son of Hezron; daughter of Shilhi, wife of king Asa, and mother of king Jehoshaphat of Judah
H5806.description: Azubah was Caleb's wife and the mother of his sons Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

H5809.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.17; § Azur or Azzur = "he that assists"; a Benjamite of Gibeon, father of the false prophet Hananiah; father of Jaazaniah, one of the princes against whom Ezekiel was commanded to prophecy
H5809.description: Azzur was the father of Jaazaniah, one of the wicked princes Ezekiel saw in a vision.

H5810.definition: to be strong ((Qal) to be strong, prevail; (Hiphil) to make firm, strengthen)

H5811.definition: A man of the tribe of Reuben  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.8;; son of: Shema (H8087H);; father of: Bela (H1106H); § Azaz = "strong"; a Reubenite, father of Bela
H5811.description: Azaz, a descendant of Reuben, was the father of Bela (1Ch.5.8).

H5812.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.15.21; § Azaziah = "Jehovah is mighty"; a Levite musician in the reign of David who played the harp in the procession which brought the ark from Obed-edom to Jerusalem; a Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah in charge of the tithes; father of Hoshea, prince of the tribe of Ephraim when David took the census
H5812.description: Azaziah was a Levite musician who played the harp during the reign of King David (1Ch.15.21).

H5813.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.5;; son of: Bukki (H1231H);; father of: Zerahiah (H2228); § Uzzi = "strong"; a Levite, son of Bukki and father of Zerahiah in the line of the high priest although apparently never high priest himself; son of Tola and grandson of Issachar; a Benjamite, son of Bela and head of a family of Benjamin; son of Michri and father of Elah and an ancestor of a family of returned exiles settling in Jerusalem. Maybe same as 3; a Levite, son of Bani, and an overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; a priest, chief of the father's house of Jedaiah, in the time of Joiakim the high priest; one of the priests who helped Ezra in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem. Maybe same as 6
H5813.description: Uzzi was a high priest in the lineage of Eleazar, son of Aaron.

H5814.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.44; § Uzzia = "strength of Jehovah"; one of David's mighty warriors
H5814.description: Uzzia the Ashterathite was one of David's mighty warriors.

H5815.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; also called Aziel at 1Ch.15.20;; Another name of ya.a.zi.el (יַעֲזִיאֵל "Jaaziel" H3268); § Aziel = "whom God comforts"; a Levite; also 'Jaaziel'

H5816.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.18;; son of: Kohath (H6955);; brother of: Amram (H6019), Izhar (H3324) and Hebron (H2275B);; father of: Mishael (H4332), Elizaphan (H0469), Sithri (H5644), Micah (H4318J) and Isshiah (H3449I); Also named: oz.zi.e.li (עׇזִּיאֵלִי "Uzzielite" H5817); § Uzziel = "my strength is God"; the 4th son of Kohath and grandson of Levi, uncle of Moses and Aaron; a Simeonite captain, son of Ishi, in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah; descendant of Bela, head of a family in the tribe of Benjamin; a musician of the sons of Heman in the time of David; a Levite of the sons of Jeduthun in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah; son of Harhaiah, probably a priest and a goldsmith, who took part in repairing the wall under Nehemiah
H5816.description: Uzziel (Azarel), a Levite musician, served during David's reign.

H5817.definition: Someone descended from Uzziel who was a man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.18;; son of: Kohath (H6955);; brother of: Amram (H6019), Izhar (H3324) and Hebron (H2275B);; father of: Mishael (H4332), Elizaphan (H0469), Sithri (H5644), Micah (H4318J) and Isshiah (H3449I); Group of uz.zi.el (עֻזִּיאֵל "Uzziel" H5816); § Uzzielites, of Uzziel "my strength is God"; descendants of Uzziel

H5818.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.14.21;; son of: Amaziah (H0558) and Jecoliah (H3203); married to Jerusha (H3388);; father of: Jotham (H3147H); also called Azariah at 2Ki.14.21; 15.1,6,7,8,17,23,27; 1xKJV: Ozias at Mat.1.8,9;; § Uzziah = "my strength is Jehovah"; son of king Amaziah of Judah and king of Judah himself for 52 years; also 'Azariah'; a Kohathite Levite and ancestor of Samuel; a priest of the sons of Harim who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; a Judaite, father of Athaiah or Uthai; father of Jehonathan, one of David's overseers
H5818.description: Uzziah was in charge of King David's storehouses.

H5819.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.27; § Aziza = "strong"; a layman of the family of Zattu who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
H5819.description: Aziza, a descendant of Zattu, was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra (Ezr.10.27).

H5820.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.31; § Azmaveth = "strong unto death"; one of David's mighty warriors; a descendant of Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan and grandson of king Saul; a Benjamite, father of Jeziel and Pelet who were two of David's men who joined him at Ziklag; overseer of the royal treasures in the reign of David; a place in Benjamin; also 'Beth-azmeveth'
H5820.description: Azmaveth, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul (1Ch.12.3).

H5821.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.26;; father of: Paltiel (H6409); § Azzan = "very strong"; father of Paltiel prince of the tribe of Issachar who represented his tribe in the division of the promised land
H5821.description: Azzan was the father of Paltiel, a leader from Issachar chosen to help divide Canaan.

H5822.definition: an unclean bird of prey (osprey, black eagle, buzzard; perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown)

children.text: perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown

H5825.definition: § Azekah = "dug over"; a town in the lowlands of Judah
H5825.description: Azekah, a Judean town, was the site of several battles and sieges.

H5826.definition: to help, succour, support ((Qal) to help; (Niphal) to be helped; (Hiphil) to help)

H5827.definition: A man of the tribe of Ephraim living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.21;; son of: Ephraim (H0669);; brother of: Shuthelah (H7803), Becher (H1071H), Tahan (H8465), Elead (H0496) and Beriah (H1283H); § Ezer = "treasure"; son of Ephraim who was slain by inhabitants of Gath; a priest who helped at the dedication of the walls of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

H5828.definition: help, succour (help, succour; one who helps)

H5829.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.4;; son of: Hur (H2354);; brother of: Uri (H0221), Shobal (H7732H), Salma (H8007H), Hareph (H2780), Jezreel (H3157J), Ishma (H3457), Idbash (H3031), Hazzelelponi (H6753) and Penuel (H6439H);; father of: Hushah (H2364); § Ezer = "treasure"; father of Hushah of the sons of Hur; a Gadite chief who fought with David; a Levite who aided in repairing the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
H5829.description: Ezer was a Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

H5830.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.7.1;; son of: Seraiah (H8304H);; brother of: Jehozadak (H3087); Also named: ez.ra (עֶזְרָא "Ezra" H5831); § Ezra = "help"; the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in Jerusalem; co-worker with Nehemiah; a priest with Zerubbabel; another post-exilic Jew
H5830.description: Ezra was a priest and scribe who led a group of Jewish exiles back to Jerusalem and played a key role in the spiritual reformation of the people.

H5831.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.7.1;; son of: Seraiah (H8304H);; brother of: Jehozadak (H3087); Aramaic of ez.ra (עֶזְרָא "Ezra" H5830); § Ezra = "help"; the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in Jerusalem; co-worker with Nehemiah

H5832.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.6; § Azarael or Azareel = "God has helped"; a Korhite warrior of David who joined him at Ziklag; a Levite musician of the family of Heman in the time of David; a Danite, son of Jeroham and a prince of the tribe at the census of David; one of the sons of Bani who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; a priest, ancestor of Maasiai or Amashai, a priest in Jerusalem after the return from exile; a priest and musician in the time of Nehemiah
H5832.description: Azarel was one of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag (1Ch.12.6).

H5833.definition: help, succour, assistance (help, succour; one who helps)

H5834.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.17;; father of: Jether (H3500J), Mered (H4778), Epher (H6081H) and Jalon (H3210); § Ezra = "help"; a Judaite, father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon
H5834.description: Ezrah was a son of Chelub, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H5835.definition: enclosure (ledge (surrounding Ezekiel's altar); court (outer one of temple))

H5836.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.26;; son of: Chelub (H3620H); § Ezri = "help of Jehovah"; son of Chelub and superintendent of king David's farm labourers
H5836.description: Ezri was the overseer of King David's agricultural workers who tilled the soil.

H5837.definition: A man of the tribe of Manasseh  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.24; § Azriel = "my help is God"; a head of a house of the half-tribe of Manasseh beyond the Jordan; a Naphtalite, ancestor of Jerimoth, the head of the tribe at the time of the census of David; father of Seraiah, an officer of king Jehoiakim of Judah
H5837.description: Azriel son of Jeremoth was the ruler of the tribe of Naphtali during the reign of King David (1Ch.27.19).

H5838.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.4.2;; son of: Ahimaaz (H0290H);; father of: Johanan (H3110J); § Azariah = "Jehovah has helped"; son of king Amaziah of Judah and king of Judah himself for 52 years; also 'Uzziah'; the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; H5840.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.3.23;; son of: Neariah (H5294);; brother of: Elioenai (H0454B) and Hizkiah (H2396H); § Azrikam = "help against the enemy"; son of Neariah and descendant of Zerubbabel of the royal line of Judah; a Benjamite, eldest son of Azel and descendant of Saul; a Levite, ancestor of Shemaiah in the time of Nehemiah; governor of the palace of king Ahaz of Judah and victim of murder by Zichri
H5840.description: Azrikam was a descendant of David through Jehoiachin.

H5841.definition: Gazathites or Gazites, of Gaza "the strong"; an inhabitant of the city of Gaza; Another name of az.zah (עַזָּה "Gaza" H5804)

reed pen used on a roll

H5848.definition: to turn aside ((Qal) to turn aside, turn (in order to cover))

H5851.definition: A womanof the tribe of Judah  living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.26; married to Jerahmeel (H3396);; mother of: Onam (H0208H); § Atarah = "a crown"; wife of Jerahmeel and mother of Onam
H5851.description: Atarah was the wife of Jerahmeel and the mother of Onam, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah (1Ch.2.26).

H5852.definition: § Ataroth = "crowns"; a town east of the Jordan in Gilead, taken and built by the tribe of Gad
H5852.description: Ataroth, a town on the border between the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.

H5853.definition: § Ataroth-adar or Ataroth-addar = "crowns of glory"; a Gadite town on the west border of Benjamin
H5853.description: Ataroth-addar, a border town between the territories of Ephraim and Benjamin.

H5854.definition: § Ataroth = "the crowns of"; the house of Joab, a place in Judah
H5854.description: Atroth-beth-joab was a town linked to Joab in Judah. (1Ch.2.54)

H5855.definition: § Atroth-shophan = "crowns of their rapine"; a town in the territory of Gad
H5855.description: Atroth-shophan was a town given to the tribe of Gad. (Numbers 32:35)

H5856.definition: ruin, heap of ruins; Also means: be.i (בְּעִי "ruins" H1164)

H2896f1.definition: good, better (feminine adjective from tov, H2896); Ruth is 'better to you than seven sons' (Ruth 4:15)

R001.definition: Jewish law; a legal ruling or established practice derived from Torah interpretation (from halak, 'to walk' — the way one walks/lives). Plural: halakhot.

R002.definition: intention, directed focus in prayer; the rabbis taught that prayer without kavanah is like a body without a soul (Berakhot 31a). Derived from Hannah's example.

R003.definition: commandments (plural of mitzvah); the 613 commandments of the Torah that Ruth accepted upon herself (Ruth 1:16, per Yevamot 47b).

R004.definition: appointed times, festivals (plural of moed, H4150); the seven annual festivals established in Leviticus 23, including Shavuot when Ruth is read.

R005.definition: scrolls (plural of megillah); the five Megillot are short books read at Jewish festivals: Song of Songs (Passover), Ruth (Shavuot), Lamentations (Tisha B'Av), Ecclesiastes (Sukkot), Esther (Purim).

R006.definition: Writings; the third division of the Hebrew Bible (Tanakh), after Torah and Nevi'im (Prophets). Includes Psalms, Proverbs, Job, the five Megillot, Daniel, Ezra-Nehemiah, and Chronicles.

R007.definition: counting (construct form); as in Sefirat HaOmer, the 49-day count from Passover to Shavuot (Leviticus 23:15-16). Ruth's story spans this period.

R008.definition: the omer; a measure of grain (~2.3 liters) and the first sheaf offering waved before the Lord at Passover (Leviticus 23:10-14), beginning the count to Shavuot.

R009.definition: a Moabite woman (feminine gentilic); the halachic distinction Mo'avi v'lo Mo'avit — 'a Moabite man is forbidden, but not a Moabite woman' — permitted Ruth's inclusion (Yevamot 76b).

R010.definition: unnamed, anonymous; used with peloni to mean 'so-and-so.' The anonymous kinsman in Ruth 4 is called peloni almoni — his name erased because he refused to redeem.

R011.definition: widespread, spread abroad (niphal participle of parats, H6555); in 1 Samuel 3:1 — 'there was no vision nifrats (widespread)' — prophecy existed but was not spreading.

R012.definition: tumors, swellings (often translated 'emerods' in KJV); the plague God sent upon the Philistines when they captured the Ark (1 Samuel 5:6-12).

R013.definition: from (the) father; the folk etymology of Moab (Mo'av) — parsed as me-av, 'from father,' referencing Lot's incestuous origin story (Genesis 19:37).

R014.definition: on the morrow of (construct); from Leviticus 23:11 — 'on the morrow after the Sabbath' — the disputed start date for counting the Omer to Shavuot.

R015.definition: the Sabbath (with definite article); in Leviticus 23:11, which Sabbath is meant became one of the great disputes between Pharisees and Sadducees.

R016.definition: distresses, straits (construct plural of matsoq); used in Hannah's phrase describing herself as a woman of sorrowful spirit (1 Samuel 1:15-16).

R017.definition: the triliteral root shin-mem-ayin: to hear, listen, obey (H8085). Root of Samuel's name (Shemu'el), the Shema (Deuteronomy 6:4), and the covenant principle that hearing IS obeying in Hebrew.

R018.definition: and not; common conjunction + negative particle. In the halachic formula Mo'avi v'lo Mo'avit — 'a Moabite man, and not a Moabite woman.'

G4420f1.definition: wings (accusative plural of pteryx, G4420); used in Matthew 23:37 — Christ gathering Jerusalem 'as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings' — the Greek equivalent of Hebrew kanaf.

G4420f2.definition: a wing; used in the LXX for Hebrew kanaf (wing, garment-corner). The same image of divine protection spanning Ruth 2:12 to Matthew 23:37.

G1656f1.definition: mercy, compassion, pity; the LXX's most common rendering of Hebrew chesed, though it loses the covenant-loyalty dimension.

G202f1.definition: nearest kinsman, one with right of redemption; the LXX term for Hebrew go'el in Ruth — the legal kinsman-redeemer.

G3086f1.definition: redeemer, deliverer; from lytron (ransom). Used in Acts 7:35 for Moses as deliverer; the broader LXX equivalent of go'el.

G2899f1.definition: border, fringe, tassel of a garment; used in Matthew 9:20 (woman touching Christ's hem) and Matthew 23:5 (Pharisees enlarging their fringes). The Greek equivalent of Hebrew kanaf in its garment-corner sense.

G3813f1.definition: a young boy, little child; diminutive of pais (child/servant). The LXX term for Hebrew na'ar when referring to the young Samuel.

G3816f1.definition: a child, boy, youth; also servant, attendant. Covers both dimensions of Hebrew na'ar — age and service status.

G11f1.definition: Ebenezer (transliterated from Hebrew Even ha-Ezer); the memorial stone Samuel set up after Israel's victory: 'Hitherto hath the LORD helped us' (1 Samuel 7:12).

G3037f1.definition: a stone; used broadly in LXX and NT. Christ is called 'the stone which the builders rejected' (Psalm 118:22; Matthew 21:42).

G996f1.definition: help, aid, assistance; the Greek equivalent of Hebrew ezer. Used in Hebrews 4:16 — 'find grace to help in time of need.'

G191f1.definition: to hear, listen, understand; root of English 'acoustic.' The Greek equivalent of Hebrew shama — though Greek separates hearing from obeying, while Hebrew unites them.

G5219f1.definition: to obey (literally 'to hear under,' i.e., to submit to what is heard); the Greek word that captures Hebrew shama's hearing-obeying unity. Root of English 'obey' (via Latin oboedire, 'to hear toward').

H4428_alt_melekh.definition: king (Hebrew). Disambiguates from H4430, the Aramaic of the same spelling.
